intel_2026.whatItMeans: Retail sale of bread, dry cakes, and wet cakes — bakery retail. This covers shops selling bread, pastries, cookies, and traditional Indonesian kue basah (wet cakes like klepon, dadar gulung, lapis). The key distinction: this is retail only. If you bake the products on-site, you need a manufacturing code (10710 or similar) in addition to this one. If customers eat on-premises in a cafe setting, that's 56303.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro, Small, Medium only** — there is no Besar (Large) scale entry for this code. Low risk (Rendah). Only an NIB is required, issued **automatically** (Otomatis). Fictive positive applies.

**Post-issuance obligations:**
- Submit periodic business activity reports to the Minister of Trade (Menyampaikan laporan kegiatan usaha kepada Menteri Perdagangan)

**Authority:** Governor (Gubernur) or Governor of Special Region of Jakarta.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership allowed. However, the absence of a Besar (Large) scale means very large operations may face classification questions.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG. Direct match from KBLI 2020 — same code, same scope. No structural changes.
intel_2026.baliContext: Premium bakery chains targeting the expat and tourist market are the typical PMA use case here — think artisan sourdough, French patisserie, or specialty cake shops in Seminyak, Canggu, and Ubud. BPOM actively monitors cold chain compliance and expiry labeling for bakery products, so expect inspections on storage temperature and product dating. The no-Besar-scale limitation is unusual and means if your bakery retail operation grows beyond Medium scale thresholds, you may need to restructure. Most successful foreign-owned bakeries in Bali pair this code with a manufacturing code (10710 for bakery production) so they can bake and sell under one entity.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56303 — Cafe (if customers eat pastries on-site with coffee)
- 56101 — Restaurant (if you serve full meals alongside baked goods)
- 47111 — Supermarket (if baked goods are part of a wider grocery retail)

data.judul: Perdagangan Eceran Bahan Bakar di Sarana Pengisian Bahan Bakar
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup perdagangan eceran bahan bakar minyak, bahan bakar gas, gas minyak cair (LPG), gas alam cair (LNG), atau jenis bahan bakar lain (misalnya hidrogen) di sarana pengisian bahan bakar untuk transportasi darat, laut, dan udara (seperti SPBU, SPBG, dan SPBH) untuk kendaraan bermotor seperti mobil dan sepeda motor, termasuk pula bahan bakar untuk kapal cepat/speed boat dan genset. Pada umumnya, kegiatan ini dikombinasikan dengan penjualan bahan-bahan pelumas, produk pendingin, bahan-bahan pembersih, dan barang-barang lain untuk keperluan mobil dan sepeda motor.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- perdagangan besar bahan bakar, lihat kelompok 46710;
- perdagangan eceran LPG dan bahan bakar untuk keperluan memasak atau pemanas, lihat kelompok 47772.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Retail sale of computers and accessories — desktops, laptops, tablets, monitors, printers, keyboards, mice, gaming peripherals, software packages, and related accessories. This is a pure retail code: you sell finished products to end consumers. If you assemble or manufacture computers, that's a different classification entirely. If you repair them, that's 95101.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro, Small, Medium, Large**: Low risk (Rendah). Only an NIB is required, issued **automatically** (Otomatis). Fictive positive applies.

**Post-issuance obligations:**
- Submit periodic business activity reports to the Minister of Trade (Menyampaikan laporan kegiatan usaha kepada Menteri Perdagangan)

**Authority:** Governor (Gubernur) or Governor of Special Region of Jakarta.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.

**Product compliance note:** While the retail license itself is Low Risk, imported products carry their own regulatory burden — SNI certification for electronics, SDPPI (Postel) certification for radio-frequency devices, and mandatory Bahasa Indonesia labeling. These product-level requirements are separate from the KBLI license but critical for legal sales.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG. Direct match from KBLI 2020 — same code, same scope. No structural changes to the retail classification.
intel_2026.baliContext: The computer retail market in Bali is concentrated in Denpasar — particularly around Jalan Teuku Umar and the Galael/Tiara Dewata area. For a PMA, the real regulatory burden is not the retail license (which is trivially easy) but the product compliance layer: every imported laptop, printer, or peripheral needs SNI and SDPPI certifications before it can legally be sold. This means your supply chain must go through authorized Indonesian importers who have already obtained these certifications, or you need to become a registered importer yourself (adding API-U import license requirements). The digital nomad population in Bali creates steady demand for premium laptops and peripherals, but margins are thin against online marketplaces like Tokopedia and Shopee.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 47404 — Phone & Accessories Retail (if you also sell phones)
- 47406 — Audio & Video Equipment Retail (if you stock speakers, cameras, etc.)
- 47901 — E-commerce Platform (if you sell online as well as in-store)
- 47592 — Household Appliance Retail (if you expand into general electronics)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a computer shop in Bali? KBLI 47401 is Low Risk and 100% open to PMA — but product import certifications (SNI, SDPPI) are where the real compliance burden lives.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Retail sale of pharmaceutical preparations for humans at a pharmacy (Apotek). This is the most heavily regulated retail code in the 47xxx range. An Apotek can dispense prescription drugs (obat etis), over-the-counter medications, and galenical preparations. The key distinction: only an Apotek — not a drug store (Toko Obat) — can handle prescription medications.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Menengah Tinggi (Medium-High)** across all scales (Micro/Small/Medium/Large). NIB + Standard Certificate required — issued within **14 working days** (fiktif positif applies).

**Requirements:**
- Surat Izin Praktek Apoteker (SIPA) — Pharmacist Practice License
- Surat Tanda Registrasi Apoteker (STRA) — Pharmacist Registration Certificate
- Sertifikat Kompetensi Apoteker — Pharmacist Competency Certificate

**Post-issuance obligations:**
- Must have a licensed Pharmacist (Apoteker) responsible for operations at all times
- Comply with pharmacy operational standards (storage, hygiene, temperature control)
- Submit periodic activity reports

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed. However, technical regulations may impose specific capital structures and elevated infrastructure standards for PMA pharmacies.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). No changes to scope or classification.
intel_2026.baliContext: Despite being TERBUKA 100%, foreign pharmacy operations in Bali are almost exclusively large chains — Watson's, Guardian, Century Healthcare. The barrier is not the PMA status but the regulatory depth: physical inspections of premises verify storage conditions, hygiene standards, temperature-controlled storage for specific medications, and the mandatory on-site Pharmacist. A PMA pharmacy must meet elevated service and infrastructure standards — you cannot operate a simple drug kiosk under this code. The SIPA licensing process for the responsible Pharmacist involves verification through the local Dinas Kesehatan (Health Department), which in Bali can add 4-8 weeks to your timeline. If your concept is simpler — vitamins, supplements, OTC health products — consider 47722 (Toko Obat) instead.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Retail sale of pharmaceutical preparations for humans NOT at a pharmacy — this is the Toko Obat (drug store). Can sell over-the-counter (OTC) medications, vitamins, supplements, herbal remedies, and limited pharmaceutical products. The critical distinction from 47721: a Toko Obat CANNOT dispense prescription drugs (obat etis) and CANNOT prepare galenical formulations. If it does not require a doctor's prescription, a Toko Obat can sell it.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Menengah Rendah (Medium-Low)** across all scales (Micro/Small/Medium/Large). NIB + Standard Certificate required — automatic issuance (fiktif positif applies).

**Post-issuance obligations:**
- Must have a Tenaga Teknis Kefarmasian (TTK) — Pharmaceutical Technical Personnel — supervising operations
- Submit periodic activity reports

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). No changes.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the practical entry point for foreigners who want to sell health and wellness products in Bali without the full pharmacy regulatory burden. A Toko Obat requires a TTK (Pharmaceutical Technical Personnel) rather than a full Pharmacist (Apoteker) — significantly easier to recruit and less expensive. Common in Bali's wellness scene: stores selling vitamins, supplements, herbal remedies, and health products in Ubud and Canggu. The TTK requirement is non-negotiable — operating without one risks immediate license suspension. Many health-focused concept stores combine this code with 47724 (cosmetics) and 47774 (essential oils) to cover their full product range.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 47721 — Pharmacy / Apotek (if you plan to upgrade to prescription drug dispensing)
- 47724 — Cosmetics Retail (if you also sell skincare and beauty products)
- 47774 — Essential Oil & Aromatherapy Retail (if your concept includes wellness aromatherapy)
- 47751 — Pet Shop (if you also carry pet health supplements)

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Retail of pet animals and pet supplies in a dedicated pet shop. Dogs, cats, rabbits, hamsters, fish, birds — and everything they need: food, cages, leashes, grooming products, accessories. If customers walk into your store and buy a puppy or a bag of premium dog food, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**ALL scales (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar): Low Risk (Rendah).** NIB only — automatic issuance.

**Post-issuance obligation:** Submit periodic business activity reports to the Minister of Trade.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.

**Important:** Live animal sales require compliance with animal welfare and husbandry regulations. You must NOT trade CITES-restricted or protected species without specific permits from BKSDA (Natural Resources Conservation Agency). Exotic breed sales are under increasing regulatory scrutiny.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG — direct match from KBLI 2020. Same code, same scope. No structural changes.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's growing expat community has created strong demand for premium pet shops — imported pet food brands, grooming services, and specialty breeds. Denpasar and Canggu have the highest concentration of pet shops catering to foreigners. Be aware: Bali has strict rabies control protocols, and selling dogs requires vaccination documentation. The island's stray animal NGOs (like BAWA) are well-connected and will flag any shop suspected of selling animals from puppy mills or illegal breeders. Importing exotic pets triggers additional quarantine and CITES compliance checks at Ngurah Rai.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 96900 — If you also offer pet grooming or boarding services
- 47192 — If you sell a broader mix of non-food retail goods alongside pet supplies
- 47901 — If you sell pet products through an online retail platform
- 46339 — If you wholesale pet food to other retailers
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a pet shop in Bali? 47751 is low risk and fully open to foreign investors — but live animal sales come with welfare and CITES compliance requirements.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Retail of aromatics and essential oils — minyak asiri. Eucalyptus oil, sandalwood oil, patchouli oil, clove oil, lemongrass oil, and aromatic products sold to end consumers. This is the retail code only — if you manufacture or distill the oils yourself, that falls under industrial codes.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**ALL scales (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar): Low Risk (Rendah).** NIB only — automatic issuance.

**Post-issuance obligation:** Submit periodic business activity reports to the Minister of Trade.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.

**Note:** If your essential oil products are applied to skin (massage oils, aromatherapy blends), they may require BPOM notification as cosmetics or traditional medicine. Pure essential oils sold as aromatic products (diffusers, room sprays) have a lighter regulatory path.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG — direct match from KBLI 2020. Same code, same scope. No structural changes.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's spa and wellness industry makes this code extremely relevant. Ubud alone has dozens of shops selling locally produced essential oils to tourists. The island produces high-quality lemongrass, clove, and frangipani oils. Many retail operations pair this code with spa services (96230) — selling branded essential oil lines in the spa reception area. If you're blending or formulating products (not just reselling), you may cross into manufacturing territory and need additional codes. BPOM registration is the main compliance hurdle for any product marketed with therapeutic claims.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 96230 — If you also operate a day spa or wellness center
- 47724 — If you sell cosmetics and beauty products alongside essential oils
- 47192 — If your shop carries a broader mix of non-food retail goods
- 47901 — If you sell essential oils through an online retail platform
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Selling essential oils in Bali? 47774 is low risk and fully open to PMA — but watch out for BPOM requirements if your products make skin-application or therapeutic claims.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Retail of souvenirs, handicrafts, and oleh-oleh (local specialty gifts). Carved woodwork, batik souvenirs, silver trinkets, hand-woven textiles, local food specialties packaged as gifts — anything tourists buy to bring home. If your shop sells handmade or locally produced items aimed at visitors and gift buyers, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**ALL scales (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar): Low Risk (Rendah).** NIB only — automatic issuance.

**Post-issuance obligation:** Submit periodic business activity reports to the Minister of Trade.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.

**Important for PMA exporters:** If you operate as both a retail gallery AND an export business, you need multi-KBLI registration — 46xxx codes for wholesale/export alongside 47781 for retail. If your business is export-only (no domestic retail sales), do NOT register 47xxx codes to avoid triggering domestic retail VAT obligations unnecessarily.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE — this code was aggregated from multiple 2020 codes covering souvenirs, handicrafts, and local specialties into a single unified retail code. Simpler classification than before.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the lifeblood of Gianyar's economy — the art markets of Ubud, Sukawati, Celuk, and Tegallalang are almost entirely built on this code. Foreign gallery owners in Ubud typically register 47781 for retail and add 46100 for wholesale commission if they export to overseas buyers. The common mistake: registering both retail (47xxx) and wholesale (46xxx) codes when you only export — this creates unnecessary domestic VAT exposure. If you're purely an exporter buying from Balinese artisans, stick to wholesale codes only. For gallery owners who also sell to walk-in tourists, 47781 is the correct primary code.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 47782 — If you also sell paintings and fine art
- 46100 — If you act as a wholesale commission agent for exports
- 47192 — If your shop sells a broader general retail mix
- 90120 — If you also create or commission original art works
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening a souvenir shop or artisan gallery in Bali? 47781 is fully open to PMA — but if you also export, the multi-KBLI structure matters for your tax setup.

If customers walk into your gallery and purchase artwork, this is the code. This does NOT cover the creation of art (that is 90120) — this is purely the retail sale.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**ALL scales (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar): Low Risk (Rendah).** NIB only — automatic issuance.

**Post-issuance obligation:** Submit periodic business activity reports to the Minister of Trade.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG — direct match from KBLI 2020. Same code, same scope. No structural changes.
intel_2026.baliContext: Ubud is the epicenter of Bali's art scene — the Neka Art Museum, ARMA, and dozens of private galleries line the streets. For foreign art collectors turned gallery owners, 47782 is the standard entry code. The critical distinction: if you are both an artist and a gallery owner, you need 90120 (visual arts creation) for production and 47782 for retail. Do not conflate the two — they have different regulatory profiles. Many Ubud galleries also sell handicrafts and souvenirs alongside paintings, which requires adding 47781. The Bali art market is heavily cash-based, which creates bookkeeping challenges for PMA entities that need clean financial records for annual tax reporting.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 90120 — If you or your artists also create the artwork (production side)
- 47781 — If you sell souvenirs and handicrafts alongside paintings
- 46100 — If you act as a wholesale commission agent exporting art internationally
- 90310 — If you operate an arts venue or exhibition space
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Opening an art gallery in Bali? 47782 covers retail of paintings and is fully open to PMA — but separate your retail code from art creation (90120) to keep your licensing clean.

Program pemasaran dan kode etik dibuat dalam Bahasa Indonesia
kewajiban: Perusahaan memberikan keterangan secara lisan dan tertulis dengan benar kepada calon penjual langsung paling sedikit mengenai: a. Identitas perusahaan b. Mutu dan spesifikasi barang c. Kondisi dan jaminan barang serta memberi penjelasan penggunaan, perbaikan dan pemeliharaannya d. Program pemasaran (marketing plan) e. Kode etik
Perusahaan yang telah melakukan perekrutan penjual langsung wajib:
Memberikan alat bantu penjualan (starter kit) kepada setiap penjual langsung yang paling sedikit berisikan keterangan mengenai barang, program pemasaran (marketing plan) dan kode etik
Memastikan kegiatan yang dilakukan oleh penjual langsung sesuai dengan program pemasaran (marketing plan) dan kode etik
Mencantumkan label pada barang dan/atau kemasan yang memuat paling sedikit nama Perusahaan dan keterangan bahwa barang dijual dengan sistem penjualan langsung (direct selling)
Menetapkan harga barang yang dijual dalam mata uang rupiah dan berlaku untuk penjual langsung dan konsumen
Memberikan komisi dan/atau bonus berdasarkan hasil kegiatan penjualan barang yang dilakukan oleh penjual langsung dan jaringannya sesuai dengan yang diperjanjikan

Memberikan tenggang waktu kepada konsumen untuk mengembalikan barang dengan jangka waktu 7 (tujuh) Hari terhitung sejak barang diterima, apabila ternyata barang tersebut tidak sesuai dengan yang diperjanjikan
Memberi kompensasi, ganti rugi dan/atau penggantian atas kerugian yang ditimbulkan akibat penggunaan, pemakaian, dan pemanfaatan barang yang diperdagangkan

Melaksanakan pembinaan dan pelatihan untuk meningkatkan kemampuan dan pengetahuan para penjual langsung, agar bertindak dengan benar, jujur, dan bertanggung jawab paling sedikit 1 (satu) sekali dalam 1 (satu) tahun
Memberikan kesempatan yang sama kepada semua penjual langsung untuk berprestasi dalam memasarkan barang
Memiliki daftar penjual langsung yang menjadi anggota jaringan pemasarannya yang dilengkapi dengan data identitas penjual langsung dimaksud
Menjual barang yang telah memiliki izin edar atau telah memenuhi ketentuan standar mutu sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan
Memastikan penjual langsung tidak menjual barang melalui saluran distribusi tidak langsung dan/atau online market place
Menyampaikan laporan tahunan kegiatan usaha penjualan langsung kepada Menteri Perdagangan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Retail intermediary services via other media — mail order, catalog sales, online retail through non-platform channels, TV shopping. If you sell products directly to consumers through channels that aren't a physical store or a digital marketplace platform, this is the code. Critical distinction: selling your own goods = retailer (this code); providing a platform for others to sell = digital platform (63xxx).
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Rendah (Low)** for most retail intermediary activities (all scales). Only NIB required. However, direct selling (MLM/network marketing) at Large scale is **Tinggi (High)** — requires NIB + Izin, PT structure, marketing plan, code of ethics, and Ministry-level approval within 5 days.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Aggregated from multiple 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE) — combines 47909 with 12 subsidiary PP28 codes covering various retail intermediary types including online retail, direct selling, and auction houses.
intel_2026.baliContext: Common code for D2C (direct-to-consumer) brands selling online from Bali — surfwear brands, organic skincare lines, artisan crafts. If you're running a Shopify store from Canggu shipping products directly to customers, this is your code. But if you're building a marketplace where other sellers list products, you need 63900 (web portal) or 63122 instead.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 47901 — If you sell through dedicated online retail platforms
- 63900 — If you operate a web portal or marketplace
- 62110 — If you also develop the software/platform yourself
- 53200 — If you handle your own courier/delivery logistics
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Selling products online from Bali? 47909 covers non-platform D2C retail — let me explain the distinction from marketplace codes.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: General cargo road transport — operating trucks, pickups, and box vans to transport various types of goods on public roads. This is commercial freight transport that accepts different cargo types in a single vehicle, not specialized hazardous or refrigerated cargo.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro / Small / Medium / Large scale**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate — issued within 5 working days.

**Micro / Small / Medium / Large scale**: High risk. NIB dan Izin — issued within 5 working days.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered/adjusted from KBLI 2020. KBLI 2020: 49431 → KBLI 2025: 49231 (ANGKUTAN BERMOTOR UNTUK BARANG UMUM) + 49232 (BARANG KHUSUS). Verifica quale sotto-codice copre il tipo di merce trasportata — merci pericolose
intel_2026.baliContext: Road freight is essential to Bali's supply chain — goods from Java arrive via Gilimanuk ferry port and are redistributed by truck to all corners of the island. The Gilimanuk–Denpasar corridor is the main artery. Traffic congestion in South Bali (Kuta, Seminyak, Denpasar) significantly affects delivery times and operating costs. Large truck access is restricted in Kuta/Legian tourist areas during peak hours. Driver shortages and aging fleet are ongoing operational challenges.

- 52101 — Warehousing for staging cargo

data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pemeriksaan danpengendalian keamanan penerbangan terhadap kargo atau pos yang akan diangkut menggunakan pesawat udara,termasuk pesawat udara tanpa awak (drone),untuk memenuhi standar keamanan penerbangan nasional dan internasional, sebagai bagian dari sistem keamanan rantai pasok udara. Aktivitas ini biasanya dilakukan entitas yang bergerak di bidang keagenan kargo atau pengiriman.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- aktivitas pemeriksaan keamanan kargo atau pos menggunakan metode yang telah disetujui seperti sumber radiasi pengion (zat radioaktif dan pembangkit radiasi pengion), explosive trace detection (ETD), atau prosedur keamanan internal lainnya, sebelum barang diserahkan ke maskapai;
- aktivitas pengendalian akses ke area terbatas, pengawasan terhadap pergerakan barang, pengendalian kendaraan pengangkut, serta pengawasan proses penyerahan barang kepada maskapai penerbangan.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- pemeriksaan dan pengendalian keamanan muatan penerbangan oleh penyedia penyimpanan dan pergudangan, lihat subgolongan 5210;
- pemeriksaan dan pengendalian keamanan muatan penerbangan oleh pos dan kurir, lihat golongan pokok 53.

data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas layanan pos yang dijalankan berdasarkan kewajiban layanan universal oleh satu atau lebih penyedia layanan universal yang ditunjuk, yaitu pengiriman pos jenis tertentu yang wajib dijamin oleh pemerintah untuk menjangkau seluruh wilayah dalam negeri yang memungkinkan masyarakat mengirimkan dan/atau menerima kiriman dari satu tempat ke tempat lain di dunia. Kegiatan yang dilakukan meliputi penggunaan infrastruktur layanan universal, termasuk lokasi ritel, fasilitas penyortiran dan pengolahan, serta jalur pengiriman untuk mengambil dan mengantarkan surat. Pengiriman dapat mencakup surat pos, yaitu surat, kartu pos, dokumen cetak (koran, majalah, materi iklan, barang cetakan dalam kantong khusus, dan sebagainya), paket kecil, paket, sekogram, barang atau dokumen lainnya, termasuk juga jasa lain yang diperlukan untuk mendukung kewajiban layanan universal.
Kelompok ini mencakup
- pengambilan, penyortiran, pengangkutan, dan pengiriman (domestik atau internasional) dengan layanan pos yang beroperasi di bawah kewajiban pelayanan universal, yang meliputi surat, kartu pos, dokumen cetak, dan paket kecil (surat berisi barang), sekogram, barang cetakan yang dikirim dalam kantong khusus yang ditujukan untuk penerima dengan alamat yang sama, dan paket pos. satu atau lebih moda transportasi dapat digunakan, dan aktivitas ini dapat dilakukan dengan menggunakan transportasi milik sendiri (pribadi) atau transportasi umum;
- pengumpulan surat dan paket dari kotak surat umum atau dari kantor pos.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- aktivitas giro pos, tabungan pos, dan pengiriman uang melalui wesel, lihat subgolongan 6419.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Five-star hotels — the top tier of Indonesian hotel classification. Full-service luxury accommodation with daily or weekly stays in a dedicated building. Think Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, Bulgari-level operations. Rooms, suites, restaurants, pools, spas, concierge — the works.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small / Medium / Large**: Two licensing tiers exist.
- **Medium-Low risk path**: NIB + Standard Certificate, issued **automatically**. Self-Assessment document required covering facilities, organization, HR, and products/services. Health Feasibility Certificate needed.
- **Medium-High risk path** (higher tier): NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 working days**. Requires Self-Assessment plus LSPr-certified tourism business standard.

**Micro + Small + Medium**: Separate Medium-Low entry with periodic reporting and health cert.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: In KBLI 2020, ALL star-rated hotels were under a single code: 55110. In 2025, that one code was split into 55101 (5-star), 55102 (4-star), 55103 (3-star), 55104 (2-star), and 55105 (1-star). Your licensing data still comes from the old 55110 PP28 entry, but your KBLI code is now specific to your star rating. This is a CODICE_RINUMERATO — renumbered, not restructured.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has some of the world's most famous five-star properties. Nusa Dua is the traditional luxury hotel corridor. Uluwatu and Ubud have attracted the newest luxury builds. If you're entering this space, know that Bali's hotel classification is enforced by the Tourism Ministry and star ratings require physical inspections. The investment threshold for a five-star hotel is massive — we're talking tens of millions of dollars minimum. Foreign investors typically structure through a PT PMA. Land acquisition in Bali is complex: foreigners can't own freehold land, so you'll use Hak Pakai (right to use) or Hak Guna Bangunan (building rights) structures.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — Hotel restaurant (almost always needed)
- 56301 — Hotel bar
- 96230 — If you have a spa facility
- 93116 — If you have gym/fitness facilities
- 79110 — If you offer travel agent services in-house
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Planning a five-star hotel in Bali? 55101 is your code — split from the old 55110 in 2025. Let me walk you through the licensing tiers.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Two-Star Hotels — commercial accommodation businesses that rent out furnished rooms or suites on a short-term basis. This classification covers entire or partial buildings equipped with dedicated front desk customer service, daily housekeeping, and food/beverage services. It strictly applies to standardized hotel operations and excludes standard residential villas or unclassified homestays.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
PP28 data inherited from parent code 55110. Three distinct licensing tiers exist:

**Tier 1 — Kecil/Menengah/Besar**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically** (Otomatis). Self-Assessment document covering Hotel Star standards (Sarana, Organisasi, SDM, Pelayanan, Produk, Manajemen). Health Feasibility Certificate required. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 2 — Kecil/Menengah/Besar**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 days**. Self-Assessment required. Must obtain LSPr-certified Tourism Business Standard. Health Feasibility Certificate. TKA documentation required if employing foreign workers. Authority: Gubernur.

**Tier 3 — Mikro/Kecil**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 days**. Same LSPr certification and Health Certificate requirements. Authority: Gubernur.

**Important:** Even Mikro-scale hotels carry Medium-High risk under Tier 3 — there is NO low-risk path for any hotel operation regardless of size.

**Post-issuance obligations across all tiers:**
- Obtain a Health Feasibility Certificate (Sertifikat Laik Sehat)
- Obtain an Alcohol Direct Sales Certificate (SKPL A, B, or C) if serving alcohol
- Submit Self-Assessment Document (Dokumen Penilaian Mandiri Kesiapan Penerapan Standar usaha Hotel Bintang)

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: CODICE_RINUMERATO. This code has been renumbered and split from the older KBLI 2020 code 55110 (Hotel Bintang) to specifically isolate two-star hotel classifications.
intel_2026.baliContext: Two-star hotels in Bali frequently take the shape of premium surf camps, digital nomad lodges, or boutique budget stays in hotspots like Batu Bolong, Padang Padang, and central Ubud. Setting up a formal hotel requires robust zoning compliance; your land must be located in a commercial or tourism zone (Kawasan Pariwisata). Unlike a simple villa, a two-star hotel involves 24/7 operational overheads, staff facilities, and heavy scrutiny over commercial building permits (PBG). Expect construction costs for a typical 20-room lodge in a secondary location to start around IDR 5-8 billion, plus a hefty land lease (Hak Sewa) running IDR 15-25 million per are per year. Navigating local banjar relations is essential if you plan to secure an alcohol permit (SKPL) for your pool bar.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — Restaurants (for your on-site dining venue)
- 56301 — Bars (if you operate a dedicated alcohol-serving venue)
- 77100 — Vehicle Rental (if you rent scooters to guests)
- 96230 — Spa/Sauna (if you offer on-site spa facilities)

While cheaper to build than a 2-star property, it still requires formal LSPr (Tourism Certification Body) audits. A common trap for foreign investors is treating this like a small homestay; the OSS system views it as a formal commercial hotel, meaning your environmental documents (SPPL/UKL-UPL) and wastewater management (IPAL) will be strictly monitored by the local environmental agency (DLHK).

intel_2026.baliContext: Homestays are the heart of Balinese tourism hospitality. Keep in mind: Bali's awig-awig (customary village rules) can impose additional conditions — some banjars require a contribution or approval before you can host tourists. Also, your building must genuinely be a residence where the owner lives, not a converted villa pretending to be a homestay.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Villas — private houses exclusively rented out to tourists, with facilities, managed by the owner. Unlike a homestay (55201), the owner does not live on the same property. These are dedicated short-stay rental properties: the classic Bali villa experience with a private pool, tropical garden, and often resident staff. One villa or an entire compound — this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro + Small + Medium**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Sertifikat Standar issued **automatically** via OSS (Otomatis).

**Step-by-step to operate legally:**
1. **PT PMA incorporation** — notary deed, AHU registration, TDP (~2–4 weeks, IDR 8–15M notary fees)
2. **NIB via OSS** — register on oss.go.id, select 55203, auto-issued (1–3 days)
3. **Sertifikat Standar** — auto-issued with NIB for Menengah Rendah
4. **KKPR** (Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang) — spatial conformity, from ATR/BPN (2–6 weeks, if land zoning requires it)
5. **PBG** (Persetujuan Bangunan Gedung) — building permit, replaces IMB since 2022 (4–12 weeks)
6. **Sertifikat Laik Sehat** — health feasibility certificate from Dinas Kesehatan (2–4 weeks)
7. **Tanda Daftar Usaha Pariwisata (TDUP)** — tourism business registration from Dinas Pariwisata Kabupaten

**Typical total timeline:** 3–5 months from PT PMA to fully operational.
**Minimum PT PMA capital:** IDR 10 billion stated capital (Rp 2.5B paid-up).

**Authority:** Bupati/Walikota (district/city level).
**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership. No local partner required.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered from 55193 in KBLI 2020 to 55203 in 2025 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). PP28 licensing data maps from old code 55193 with a 100% match — same risk level, same permits, same obligations. No substantive change for operators: if you are running under 55193, the transition to 55203 is administrative only.
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Running a villa in Bali? 55203 is the most popular accommodation code among foreign investors — and also the most regulated. Let me walk you through exactly what you need, the real costs, and the traps to avoid.
intel_2026.baliContext:
**🏝 The Bali Villa Market (Reality Check)**
- Villas ARE Bali's tourism identity: Seminyak, Canggu, Ubud, Uluwatu, Sanur — every area has its scene
- Most popular accommodation KBLI for foreign investors by volume
- Typical structure: PT PMA leases land (Hak Sewa, 25–30 years), builds villa, rents on Airbnb/Booking.com
- **Oversupply warning:** Canggu and Seminyak have thousands of villas competing for the same guests; occupancy rates have dropped significantly since 2022
- **Better ROI areas (2025):** Tabanan, Sidemen (Karangasem), Amed, north coast — lower land prices, growing demand

**💸 Real Costs to Budget**
- Land lease (Hak Sewa, 25 years, Canggu): IDR 1.5–4B per are (100m²)
- Villa construction (mid-range): IDR 8–15M per m²
- PT PMA setup (notary + legal): IDR 8–15M
- TDUP + permits + PBG: IDR 5–15M total
- Monthly operational (staff, maintenance, pool, gardener): IDR 15–40M depending on size

**⚠ Common Mistakes That Kill the Business**
- **Operating without TDUP** — Dinas Pariwisata enforcement intensified in 2023–2024; fines and closure orders have been executed in Canggu, Pererenan, and Seminyak
- **Building before PBG** — IMB/PBG crackdowns since 2024 have resulted in actual demolition orders in Bali
- **Skipping Sertifikat Laik Sehat** — required for legal operation; without it your NIB is valid but your villa is not
- **Ignoring the banjar** — local village council approval is not a government permit but is socially and operationally essential; no banjar consent = neighbor problems, access issues, staff walkouts
- **Nominee land ownership** — still common, still illegal; BPN and PPATK have increased scrutiny on nominee arrangements since 2023

- **68112** — For the property lease/rental structure (if your PT PMA also holds the lease)
- **96230** — If you offer spa or massage services at the villa
- **79110** — If you arrange tours, activities, or transfers for guests
- **77311** — If you rent out motorbikes, scooters, or vehicles to guests
- **41012** — If your PT PMA also builds/constructs the villa itself

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Serviced apartments — apartments managed and operated as hotels for short-term stays, with payment calculated per-night or per-period. Think aparthotel (apartel) or condotel (kondotel). The unit is an apartment by design, but it functions as a hotel room: housekeeping, front desk, daily rates. This is *not* a long-term residential lease — it's hospitality accommodation in apartment form.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro + Small**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Sertifikat Standar, but requires a **Self-Assessment Readiness Document** (Dokumen Penilaian Mandiri Kesiapan Penerapan Standar). Processing: 14 days (Jangka Waktu: 14 Hari).

Post-issuance obligations:
- Obtain a Health Feasibility Certificate (Sertifikat Laik Sehat)
- Obtain a tourism business standard certificate from an accredited LSPr (Sertifikat Standar Usaha Pariwisata dari Lembaga Sertifikasi Profesi)

**Authority:** Governor (Gubernur) — provincial level, not Bupati/Walikota. This signals a higher regulatory bar than villas or homestays.

**PMA:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

Note: Renumbered from old code 55194 (Apartemen Hotel), same licensing substance.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered from 55194 in KBLI 2020 to 55204 in 2025 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). The PP28 licensing data comes from the old 55194 entry with a perfect 100% match. Same business, new code number. The key difference from villas (55203): aparthotels carry **Medium-High** risk, require Governor-level approval, and need LSPr certification — villas are Medium-Low with automatic issuance.
intel_2026.baliContext: Aparthotels are growing fast in Bali, especially in Seminyak, Kuta, and the Canggu-Berawa corridor. The model is popular with developers: build apartment units, sell them to individual investors, then manage the entire building as a hotel — the owner gets rental income, the operator runs it like a hotel. Condotels in Bali have been controversial (many buyers felt misled about returns), but the model persists because it works for both parties when managed well. Regulatory scrutiny is increasing — the Governor-level licensing reflects this. Occupancy can be excellent in prime locations (70-85% in peak season), but the per-night rate is typically lower than equivalent star-rated hotels. The sweet spot is lifestyle travelers who want a kitchen, washing machine, and living space but still want hotel services. Canggu and Uluwatu are seeing the newest developments in this category.

- 68112 — For the underlying property lease/rental structure
- 96230 — If you offer spa or wellness services
- 93116 — If you include gym/fitness facilities
- 55400 — If you list on OTAs (accommodation intermediary activity)

intel_2026.baliContext: THIS IS THE 'MISSING LINK' CODE. 55901 legalizes the widespread but often unlicensed practice of villa management companies. Hundreds of Bali businesses manage villas on behalf of absent owners — handling check-ins, cleaning, maintenance, Airbnb listings, guest communication. Previously, this was done informally. Under KBLI 2025, any entity managing accommodation for others MUST hold this code. For PMA investors, this offers a SCALABLE business model: manage 50-100 villas without owning the underlying land or buildings. The management fee structure (typically 20-30% of rental income) creates recurring revenue without property risk. Compare with 68292 (Real Estate Management) which covers the property itself rather than the hospitality operation.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: This is your classic restaurant code — any place that serves food in a permanent building. Sit-down restaurants, warungs with concrete walls, fast food joints, food courts inside malls, even hotel restaurants. If people walk in, sit down, and eat food you cooked in a fixed building, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro scale** (smallest operations): Medium-Low risk. You get your NIB + Standard Certificate automatically — no waiting. You'll need a Hygiene Sanitation Label (HSP) and must submit periodic activity reports.

**Small / Medium / Large scale**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate issued within **14 working days**. You'll need a Self-Assessment of Standard Readiness, a certified standard from an LSPr (certification body), and a Hygiene Sanitation Feasibility Certificate (SLHS).

**PMA (foreign investment):** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Big change in 2025. The old 56101 (restaurants) got merged with three other codes: 56103 (food stalls/tents), 56104 (self-service restaurants), and 56109 (other fixed-building food). So if you had a cafeteria-style or self-service setup under a separate code before, it's all 56101 now. One code to rule them all for fixed-building food service.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the single most common business code for foreigners in Bali. Seminyak, Canggu, and Ubud are saturated — the competition is fierce and landlords know it. Sanur and Uluwatu still have room. Keep in mind: Bali's health department (Dinas Kesehatan) does actual inspections for your SLHS, and they check kitchen hygiene, water quality, and food storage. Budget 2-4 weeks for the inspection alone. Also, most Bali restaurants need a separate liquor license if they serve alcohol — 56101 alone doesn't cover that.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56301 — If you serve alcohol (bar license, required for cocktails and spirits)
- 56303 — If you also operate as a café/coffee shop
- 47221 — If you sell retail beverages (bottled drinks to go)
- 68112 — If you're leasing the building yourself

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Night clubs — establishments primarily serving beverages alongside dance facilities, live music, and light shows. Includes hostesses/attendants for VIP service and entertainment acts. This is NOT just a bar with music — it's a specifically defined nightlife category with spettacoli (shows) and operational reality checks.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Medium/Large scale ONLY** (no Micro/Small). Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate verified within **14 days**. Must obtain LSPr certification and Sertifikat Laik Sehat.

**CRITICAL:** Requires SKPL-A (or B and C) alcohol license — subject to strict regional quotas. Authority: Governor (not local Bupati).

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG — code unchanged, but enforcement has dramatically intensified since 2024.
intel_2026.baliContext: THIS IS THE MOST DANGEROUS CODE IN BALI. Satpol PP (Public Order Enforcement) now classifies venues by operational reality, not license text. If you have a DJ booth, dance floor, and ticketed entry, you ARE 56302 regardless of what your NIB says. CRITICAL ZONING: 56302 is PROHIBITED in Yellow (Residential) and Green (Agricultural) zones. Requires specific Tourism/Entertainment Zoning. Many Canggu venues operated as 'restaurants' (56101) or 'bars' while functioning as nightclubs — these face immediate closure when audited. The SKPL alcohol license is a scarce, quota-controlled asset in saturated areas like Seminyak. Noise regulations (decibel limits) are now actively enforced with professional measurement equipment.

- 56101 — Restaurant (if also serving food)

Aktivitas intermediasi ini dapat dilakukan melalui platform digital atau melalui saluran nondigital (tatap muka, telepon, pos, dll.). Balas jasa atau komisi dapat diterima baik dari klien atau dari penyedia makanan dan minuman. Pendapatan aktivitas intermediasi juga didapatkan dari sumber pemasukan lainnya, seperti pendapatan dari iklan.

- jasa reservasi restoran.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- pengoperasian platform daring yang mengizinkan orang untuk memesan layanan pengiriman makanan, lihat subgolonogan 5330.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Food trucks and mobile street food — preparing and serving food from motorized or non-motorized vehicles, carts, or mobile stalls. This includes food trucks, mobile kitchens, street food carts, and pop-up food stalls that can relocate. If your food operation moves on wheels or is designed to be mobile, this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro + Small scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically**. You need a Hygiene Sanitation Label (HSP) and periodic activity reports.

Vehicle registration and street vending permits are separate requirements from the KBLI license.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: This is a completely new code in KBLI 2025 — it didn't exist in 2020 (BPS_ONLY status). The government created it to capture the growing mobile food and street food economy. If you were running a food truck before, you were likely classified under 56102 (food stalls) or general trade codes.
intel_2026.baliContext: Food trucks are having a moment in Bali — Canggu's shortcut road, Berawa's evening spots, and beachside locations in Seminyak. Mobile food offers lower overhead than restaurants and the flexibility to follow crowds. Vehicle permits, parking agreements, and local banjar approvals are the real operational hurdles. Many food trucks partner with beach clubs or events for semi-permanent locations. For PMA investors, the lower scale means smaller investment requirements compared to full restaurants.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — If you later move into a permanent restaurant location
- 56102 — If operating from semi-permanent stalls/warungs
- 49295 — If your food truck operates as a chartered transport vehicle

data.judul: Aktivitas Produksi Film, Video, dan Program Televisi oleh Pemerintah
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pembuatan atau produksi gambar bergerak, termasuk film, video, karya audiovisual (misalnya animasi 2D, 3D, animasi stopmotion, atau gabungan dari beberapa teknik animasi tersebut), program televisi, iklan bergerak televisi, program berita televisi, vlog (video blogging), dan siniar video (podcast video) yang dikelola oleh pemerintah atas dasar balas jasa.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup
- aktivitas pembuatan konten media olahraga dalam bentuk film, video, atau program televisi yang dikelola oleh pemerintah;
- aktivitas pembuatan film untuk penayangan televisi, serta jasa pengiriman film dan agen pembukuan film yang dikelola oleh pemerintah.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- aktivitas penggandaan film dan reproduksi rekaman audio atau video pada CD, DVD, atau media fisik lainnya dari salinan master, lihat kelompok 18202;
- aktivitas animasi pascaproduksi, lihat subgolongan 5912.

Uraian tentang proyeksi pendapatan (revenue) dari iklan dan/atau pendapatan lain yang sah yang terkait dengan penyelenggaraan penyiaran c. Daftar modal yang ditempatkan dan disetor, serta susunan kepemilikan saham perusahaan d. Mencantumkan kepemilikan saham pada lembaga penyiaran swasta jasa penyiaran radio yang sudah dimiliki oleh pemegang saham e. Mencantumkan daftar media cetak, lembaga penyiaran swasta jasa penyiaran radio, lembaga penyiaran swasta jasa penyiaran televisi dan/atau lembaga penyiaran berlangganan yang sudah dimiliki oleh Pelaku Usaha f. Peta wilayah jangkauan siaran g. Sarana dan prasarana penyiaran mencakup kantor, spesifikasi perangkat, dan konfigurasi teknis sistem penyiaran
Menyampaikan daftar susunan pengurus untuk membuktikan direksi dan komisaris badan hukum Pelaku Usaha tidak ditetapkan dalam daftar hitam penyelenggara

Menyampaikan surat pernyataan: a. Sanggup membayar biaya izin penyelenggaraan penyiaran sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan b. Sanggup memenuhi dokumen kerja sama dengan penyelenggara layanan multipleksing dalam hal akan menyelenggarakan penyiaran dengan teknologi digital melalui media terestrial c. Sanggup memenuhi persyaratan izin penggunaan spektrum frekuensi radio (ISR) sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan d. Sanggup memenuhi ketentuan penyelenggaraan penyiaran sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan e. Sanggup memenuhi ketentuan terkait isi siaran sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan f. Sanggup membangun dan/atau menyediakan sarana dan prasarana penyiaran berdasarkan ketentuan peraturan perundang undangan sebelum mengajukan permohonan uji laik operasi penyiaran g. Sanggup menyampaikan dokumen yang valid dan benar
Dalam hal penyelenggaraan jasa penyiaran radio digital dengan media terrestrial, wajib melampirkan dokumen kerja sama dengan penyelenggara layanan multipleksing
Mengajukan permohonan uji laik operasi penyiaran setelah membangun dan/atau menyediakan sarana dan prasarana penyiaran berdasarkan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan
Memperoleh surat keterangan laik operasi penyiaran berdasarkan pelaksanaan uji laik operasi penyiaran sesuai standar kegiatan usaha
Membayar biaya izin penyelenggaraan penyiaran dalam jangka waktu 15 (lima belas) hari kerja sejak surat perintah pembayaran diterbitkan

Pengajuan perpanjangan Perizinan Berusaha penyelenggaraan penyiaran paling cepat 4 (empat) bulan dan paling lambat 3 (tiga) bulan sebelum berakhirnya Perizinan Berusaha penyelenggaraan penyiaran dan memenuhi catatan hasil evaluasi atau dinyatakan layak b. Tidak memiliki kewajiban Penerimaan Negara Bukan Pajak yang terhutang kepada kementerian yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang komunikasi dan informatika c. Dalam hal menggunakan spektrum frekuensi radio, wajib menyampaikan izin penggunaan spektrum frekuensi radio (ISR) yang masih berlaku d. Dalam hal menggunakan slot multipleksing, wajib menyampaikan dokumen kerja sama dengan penyelenggara layanan multipleksing sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan e. Membayar biaya Izin penyelenggaraan Penyiaran dalam jangka waktu 2 (dua) bulan sejak surat perintah pembayaran diterbitkan

kewajiban: Memenuhi standar usaha aktivitas jasa jual kembali jasa telekomunikasi

Adanya perjanjian kerja sama antara penyelenggara jasa telekomunikasi dengan pelaksana jual kembali jasa telekomunikasi, dengan ketentuan sebagai berikut: a. Pelaksana jual kembali jasa telekomunikasi menggunakan merek dagang layanan penyelenggara jasa telekomunikasi yang dijual kembali dan dapat menambahkan merek dagang pelaksana jual kembali jasa telekomunikasi kepada pelanggan (end user) b. Pelaksana jual kembali jasa telekomunikasi memenuhi ketentuan standar kualitas pelayanan jasa telekomunikasi yang telah dikomitmenkan oleh penyelenggara jasa telekomunikasi c. Seluruh pendapatan dari pelaksanaan jual kembali jasa telekomunikasi menjadi pendapatan dari dan dibukukan oleh penyelenggara jasa telekomunikasi d. Penagihan (billing) mencantumkan merek dagang penyelenggara jasa telekomunikasi e. Dalam hal jual kembali layanan jasa telekomunikasi berbasis protokol internet, pelaksana jual kembali jasa telekomunikasi wajib menggunakan alamat protokol internet (Internet Protocol Address/ IP Address) publik dan nomor sistem otonom (Autonomous System Number) milik penyelenggara jasa telekomunikasi
Menjamin perlindungan konsumen
Penyelenggara jasa telekomunikasi yang melakukan kerja sama jual kembali jasa telekomunikasi wajib menjamin keberlangsungan seluruh layanan telekomunikasi yang diselenggarakan nya

data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyelenggaraan jasa telekomunikasi berupa penyediaan jasa komunikasi data berbasis protokol internet dan/atau selain protokol internet melalui jaringan telekomunikasi dan/atau satelit asing yang telah memperoleh hak labuh (landing right) untuk memenuhi berbagai kebutuhan tertentu, dengan jaminan ketersambungan, kualitas, dan keamanan.

Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penjualan kembali jasa telekomunikasi yang diperoleh melalui kerja sama dengan Penyelenggara Jasa Telekomunikasi, termasuk aktivitas jual kembali jasa akses internet melalui jaringan antara pelanggan dan Penyedia Layanan Internet (ISP) yang tidak dimiliki atau dioperasikan oleh ISP tersebut, seperti akses Internet dial-up, dan sebagainya.
Aktivitas pada kelompok ini di dalam pelaksanaannya, Penyelenggara wajib menjamin keberlangsungan layanan, sementara pelaksana jual kembali menggunakan merek dagang Penyelenggara (dengan kemungkinan menambahkan mereknya sendiri), memenuhi standar kualitas layanan yang ditetapkan, serta seluruh pendapatan dibukukan sebagai pendapatan Penyelenggara. Penagihan (billing) dilakukan atas nama Penyelenggara Jasa Telekomunikasi. Untuk layanan berbasis protokol internet, pelaksana jual kembali wajib menggunakan alamat IP publik dan Nomor Sistem Otonom (Autonomous System Number) milik Penyelenggara Jasa Telekomunikasi.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- aktivitas penyelenggaraan jasa akses internet oleh operator telekomunikasi yang memiliki dan mengoperasikan infrastruktur jaringan sendiri, lihat kelompok 61104.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Technical development of video games — coding, engine creation, middleware, game software. Includes design/writing/testing/patching game code. Does NOT include game publishing (58211/58219) or game content design (74194).
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small / Medium scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically**. Must have SOP for after-sales service, competency training certificates, org chart with technical staff, guarantee no SARA content, age rating recommendations.

**Large scale**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate verified within **7 working days**. Needs staffing documentation (min 2 managers, 2 supervisors, 4 operational staff). Also has AI/blockchain sub-requirements (data governance annual report, SKKNI AI competency).

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed. Authority: Bupati/Walikota (small/medium), Gubernur (large).
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE from KBLI 2020 codes 62011, 62012, 62013, 62015, 62019. Previously game dev was bundled under general software programming. KBLI 2025 creates a dedicated code recognizing Indonesia's game industry as distinct.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's game dev scene is small but growing, centered in Canggu coworking spaces. Most indie studios are 2-5 person teams. The IDR 10B PMA minimum makes this prohibitive for small studios — most operate as freelancers or use nominee structures. Denpasar Technopark has programs supporting game development. The key advantage of Bali is lifestyle + lower cost than Jakarta/Singapore, attracting remote game developers. However, fast internet is still inconsistent outside south Bali.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 74194 — Game Content Design (art direction, level design, narrative)
- 58211 — Game Publishing (online distribution)
- 58219 — Other Game Publishing
- 62199 — Other Software Development (for non-game tools)
- 73100 — Advertising (if you market games directly)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Building games from Bali? 62110 is your dedicated code for game development — let me explain the licensing and what changed in 2025.

data.judul: Aktivitas Pengembangan Aplikasi Perdagangan melalui Internet (E-Commerce)
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pemrograman dan/atau pengembangan perangkat lunak aplikasi untuk mendukung transaksi perdagangan barang dan/atau jasa secara elektronik melalui internet (e-commerce). Aktivitas ini meliputi perancangan struktur dan konten, serta penulisan, modifikasi (termasuk pembaruan dan patch), kustomisasi, pengujian, dan dukungan teknis terhadap kode program komputer yang diperlukan untuk membuat dan mengimplementasikan aplikasi perdagangan melalui internet.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup aktivitas konsultansi dan penyediaan saran/masukan mengenai kebutuhan perangkat lunak yang sudah tercakup dalam kelompok 62209.

Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pemrograman dan/atau pengembangan perangkat lunak aplikasi berbasis media imersif, seperti virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), dan mixed reality (MR). Aktivitas ini meliputi perancangan struktur dan konten, serta penulisan, modifikasi (termasuk pembaruan dan patch), kustomisasi, pengujian, dan dukungan teknis terhadap kode program komputer untuk membuat dan mengimplementasikan perangkat lunak berbasis media imersif. Kelompok ini juga mencakup aktivitas pembuatan atau kustomisasi konten digital seperti visual tiga dimensi (3D visual), video 360 derajat, atau modifikasinya khusus untuk ditampilkan dan dioperasikan melalui media imersif.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup aktivitas konsultansi dan penyediaan saran/masukan mengenai kebutuhan perangkat lunak yang sudah tercakup dalam kelompok 62209.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: General software development and programming — designing, writing, modifying, testing, and supporting computer code for software systems and applications. This is the catch-all code for IT companies that build custom software, web apps, mobile apps, SaaS products, and enterprise systems. If you write code for a living and it doesn't fit into gaming (62110), e-commerce apps (62191), or AI (62194), this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small + Medium**: Two licensing paths:
- **Medium-Low risk**: NIB + Standard Certificate **automatically**. Must submit industry data reports every 6 months, have data security SOPs.
- **Medium-High risk**: 7-day processing. Needs org chart with qualified staff, employment contracts for skilled workers, business process documentation, equipment list with photos.

**Large**: Medium-High risk, 7-day processing, same requirements as above.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership. This is one of the easiest codes for foreign tech companies.
intel_2026.whatChanged: The 2025 code aggregated from the old 62029 (other computer consulting activities) via MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. The 2020 landscape had fewer, broader IT codes. Now there's more granularity — gaming, e-commerce, AI, and IoT all got their own codes, leaving 62199 as the general programming catchall.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's tech scene is real and growing. Canggu is the unofficial digital nomad capital of Southeast Asia, and many of those nomads have formed companies here. Running a software company from Bali as a PT PMA is straightforward — 100% foreign ownership, automatic licensing at smaller scales. The talent pool is a mix of Indonesian developers (Denpasar has several good universities) and international remote workers. Co-working spaces like Dojo Bali and Outpost cater specifically to tech companies. Pro tip: if your PT PMA builds software, you can employ up to 10 foreign workers on KITAS without the stringent 1:1 local hiring ratios that other industries face.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 62209 — If you also do IT consulting/managed services
- 63900 — If you operate a web portal or digital marketplace
- 62191 — If you specifically build e-commerce applications
- 62194 — If you work with AI/machine learning
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Building software from Bali? 62199 is your code — 100% PMA, automatic licensing at small scale. Here's the full picture.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Cybersecurity consulting services — planning and supervising information security, security audits, vulnerability analysis, data protection planning, policy development. Also includes developing and implementing information security systems.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**ALL scales are Medium-High risk** (no automatic issuance). NIB + Standard Certificate verified within **7 working days**.

Requires: org chart with technical SDM, staffing contracts (small: 1 technical staff; medium: 1 manager + 1 supervisor + 1 staff; large: 2 managers + 2 supervisors + 4 staff), business process documentation, equipment inventory.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE from KBLI 2020 code 62021. Previously cybersecurity was hidden within general IT consulting. KBLI 2025 extracts it as its own code, reflecting national cyber resilience priorities and BSSN (National Cyber Agency) mandates.
intel_2026.baliContext: Small but growing cybersecurity presence in Bali, mostly serving remote international clients. The Medium-High risk classification at ALL scales is notably stricter than other IT codes — reflecting national security concerns. For Bali-based cybersecurity consultancies, the main challenge is the staffing requirements: even a small firm needs formal employment contracts with technically certified staff. The good news is 100% PMA is allowed, making this one of the most accessible high-value IT niches for foreign experts.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 62199 — Other Software Development (for security tool development)
- 62202 — Digital Identity Services
- 62203 — Electronic Certificate Services
- 63101 — Data Processing (for SOC/monitoring infrastructure)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Setting up a cybersecurity consultancy in Indonesia? 62201 is your code — but be aware it's Medium-High risk at ALL scales, unlike most IT codes.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: IT consulting and computer facility management — advising on hardware/software configurations, planning and designing computer systems, managing data centers, providing system administration services. If you help businesses with their tech infrastructure rather than building software products, this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Small + Medium**: Medium-High risk. NIB + Standard Certificate within **7 working days**. Requirements are substantial:
- Org chart showing qualified technical staff
- Employment contracts for skilled workers (must be permanent employees, not freelancers)
- Business process flow documentation
- Equipment list with photos
- If producing medical devices: additional healthcare certifications
- Must submit industry data every 6 months
- SOPs for after-sales service and data security

**Large**: Same Medium-High risk, 7-day processing, same requirements.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered from 62029 in KBLI 2020 (CODICE_RINUMERATO) with a 100% match. The old code covered 'other computer consulting' activities. In 2025 it's split into more specific categories — cybersecurity (62201), digital identity (62202), electronic certificates (62203), IoT consulting (62204), and this general catch-all 62209.
intel_2026.baliContext: IT consulting in Bali serves two markets: local businesses going digital (hotels, restaurants, retail — lots of demand) and international clients served remotely. Many digital agencies in Bali operate under this code — web design firms, IT managed service providers, and system integrators. The 7-day licensing timeline is manageable. The biggest requirement hurdle is demonstrating permanent employees (not contractors), which can be tricky for lean tech operations. Denpasar and Sanur have more traditional IT firms; Canggu and Ubud skew toward digital agencies and remote consulting.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 62199 — If you also build custom software
- 62201 — If you specifically do cybersecurity consulting
- 63102 — If you provide hosting/data center services
- 95101 — If you repair computers and equipment

intel_2026.whatItMeans: The catch-all code for IT services that don't fit anywhere else — any information technology or computer service activity not specifically classified under other 62xxx codes. This includes miscellaneous IT support, niche tech services, and hybrid IT activities that straddle multiple categories.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**BPS_ONLY** — this code exists in the BPS classification but has NOT yet been assigned PP28 risk/licensing data. Currently treated as requiring only a NIB, pending formal assignment.

**CAUTION:** Using a catch-all code for a PMA company can trigger additional scrutiny from BKPM. Reviewers may ask why you didn't use a more specific code — an unsatisfying answer can delay NIB processing.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: BPS_ONLY — this code has no mapped predecessor in KBLI 2020. It exists purely in the BPS classification system without corresponding PP28 licensing parameters. Regulators focus on defining specific activities first and leave residual categories for later waves.
intel_2026.baliContext: Use this code with caution. If you're doing app development (62192), AI (62194), cybersecurity (62201), or IT consulting (62209), use those specific codes. The main legitimate use case is when your IT service genuinely doesn't fit any existing category. Some Bali business consultants recommend adding 62900 as a SECONDARY code alongside a specific primary code, giving flexibility to expand without amending your NIB. That's sound advice, but never make it your only code.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 62199 — Other Software Development (the more specific catch-all for programming)
- 62209 — IT Consulting (the more specific catch-all for consulting)
- 63900 — Web Portals & Digital Platforms
- 95101 — Computer & Peripheral Repair (if services include hardware)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Considering 62900 as your IT catch-all code? It works as a secondary code, but think carefully before making it your primary — BKPM will want to know why a specific code didn't fit.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Data Processing Activities — covering the processing and tabulation of various data types, including big data, satellite imagery, and data entry. It involves algorithm development, data migration, processing via blockchain or distributed ledger technology (DLT), digitalizing documents, and sharing computing facilities for analysis.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
Three distinct licensing tiers from aggregated PP28 sources (63121, 63111):

**Tier 1 — Kecil/Menengah**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, issued **automatically**. Validated Industrial Data reports every 6 months. Data security SOPs. HR competency training certificates. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 2 — Kecil/Menengah**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate, issued **automatically**. Same data reporting obligations plus: equipment calibration certificates, organizational structure documentation showing qualified technical staff, and safety/security guarantees for tools and processes. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 3 — Besar**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **7 days**. Requires: organizational chart with qualified staff, employment contracts for at least 2 managers + 2 supervisors + 4 technical staff (permanent or minimum 1-year contract), business process flow documentation, equipment list with photos. Authority: Gubernur.

**Post-issuance obligations (all tiers):**
- Submit validated Industrial Data every 6 months (Data Industri tervalidasi)
- Maintain SOPs for data and electronic system security (SOP keamanan data dan sistem elektronik)
- Obtain HR competency training certificates (sertifikat pelatihan kompetensi SDM)

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025 (aggregated from 63121, 63111).
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. Expanded heavily in the 2025 update to explicitly include big data, remote sensing, and blockchain/DLT processing.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has become a global hub for Web3, crypto, and AI startups. Rather than dealing with complex financial licenses, many foreign tech founders set up 'Data Processing' PT PMAs. If you are training AI models, running blockchain validator nodes, or operating a back-office data analytics hub for your overseas parent company, 63101 is your golden ticket. The explicit inclusion of blockchain gives immense legal clarity to Web3 founders. It allows you to legally hire local developers and sponsor expat IT talent with Investor KITAS. Since it requires zero physical retail presence, you can legally domicile in a co-working space in Canggu or Sanur. Just ensure your data privacy SOPs strictly comply with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection (PDP) law.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 63102 — Cloud/Hosting Infrastructure (if you also provide the servers for the data)
- 62199 — Other Computer Programming (the standard code for software engineering)
- 70209 — Management Consulting (if you advise other companies based on your data analytics)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Running an AI, Big Data, or Web3 startup from Bali? KBLI 63101 now explicitly covers blockchain and data processing, making it perfect for tech PMAs.

data.judul: Aktivitas Penyediaan Infrastruktur Komputasi, Hosting, dan Aktivitas Terkait
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyediaan infrastruktur komputasi dan hosting, serta berbagai jasa terkait lainnya yang mendukung aktivitas pengelolaan dan distribusi data secara digital, termasuk penyediaan infrastruktur komputasi awan (cloud computing), seperti layanan Infrastructure as a Service (Iaas) dan Platform as a Service (PaaS); penyediaan layanan hosting, seperti web hosting, hosting layanan streaming (tanpa mengelola atau mengkurasi konten), dan aplikasi hosting.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup penyediaan fasilitas mainframe secara bersama (time sharing) kepada klien, penyewaan ruang server dan jaringan dalam pusat data (data center colocation), penyimpanan data dan dokumen secara elektronik untuk keperluan akses terbatas, serta layanan penyimpanan data komputer lainnya.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup aktivitas pengolahan data dan entri data atas permintaan pelanggan/klien, lihat kelompok 63101.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Computing Infrastructure, Hosting, and Related Activities — providing cloud computing infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS), web hosting, application hosting, and streaming hosting (without content curation). It also covers server room colocation, electronic document storage, and sharing mainframe facilities. It explicitly excludes pure data processing.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro**: Low risk (Rendah) processed automatically. **Small, Medium**: Medium-Low (Menengah Rendah) to Medium-High risk. **Large**: Medium-High to High Risk (Tinggi). Depending on risk, requires NIB, NIB + Standard Certificate (Sertifikat Standar), or an Izin (taking up to 7 days).

**Post-issuance obligations:**
- Maintain an Electronic System Provider Registration Certificate from Kominfo (Surat Tanda Terdaftar Penyelenggara Sistem Elektronik / PSE)
- Submit validated Industrial Data (Memiliki bukti penyampaian wajib Data Industri)
- Establish consumer complaint services (Memiliki layanan pengaduan konsumen)
- Implement data security SOPs (Memiliki SOP keamanan data)

**Authority:** Ranges from Regent/Mayor (Bupati/Walikota) to Minister/Head of Agency (Menteri/Kepala Badan) depending on risk.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. Separated and updated from broader processing codes to explicitly define modern cloud infrastructure, IaaS, and PaaS models.
intel_2026.baliContext: While Bali isn't a primary location for massive Tier 4 data centers (due to power grid stability and internet redundancy limitations compared to Jakarta), boutique server hosting, specialized Web3 nodes, SaaS platforms, and localized cloud infrastructure businesses do exist here. Foreign investors use this code to legally build and manage private tech infrastructure. The critical obligation here is the PSE Registration (Surat Tanda Terdaftar Penyelenggara Sistem Elektronik) from the Ministry of Communication and Informatics (Kominfo). If you operate a commercial app or hosting service and fail to register for a PSE, the Indonesian government will block your IP address nationally. Also, power redundancy for server cooling in Bali's tropical climate will be your biggest overhead.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 63101 — Data Processing (if you also process the data hosted on your servers)
- 62209 — IT Consulting (to provide wrap-around architecture services for your clients)
- 46511 — Wholesale of Computers/Hardware (if you import and sell server racks)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Building cloud infrastructure or SaaS hosting services in Bali? KBLI 63102 is fully open to PMA, but your Kominfo PSE registration is an absolute, non-negotiable requirement.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Web portals, search engines, and fee-based information services. Think of any website or platform whose primary value is aggregating and presenting information — news portals, directory sites, vertical search engines, data lookup tools. This is NOT a marketplace or e-commerce platform (that's 63122). If your site's main product is organized information rather than facilitating transactions between buyers and sellers, 63900 is the right fit.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro scale**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only — no Standard Certificate required. This is the lightest licensing path in the entire KBLI system. You register, you get your NIB, you operate.

**Small / Medium / Large scale**: Not listed in the risk data at these scales, which means Micro is the only explicitly mapped tier. In practice, if your operation grows beyond micro, expect the licensing authority to apply at minimum Medium-Low requirements.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). No structural changes. Web portals and information services keep the same code and scope.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is a popular code for digital entrepreneurs running content sites, niche directories, or information platforms from Bali. The low-risk micro classification makes it one of the easiest tech codes to set up. Many Bali-based expats use this for travel information portals, wellness directories, or local business listing sites. Just be careful not to cross into marketplace territory — if your portal starts facilitating transactions, you may need 63122 instead.

intel_2026.baliContext: The PT PMA holding structure (64210 parent → operational subsidiaries) is the preferred structure for foreign investors with multiple business lines in Bali — it allows clean liability separation between hospitality (55101), F&B (56101), real estate (68111), and other operations. OJK supervises holding companies if financial assets exceed 50% of total assets. OECD Pillar Two global minimum tax (15%) has reduced the tax arbitrage benefit of holding structures, but operational benefits remain significant.

OJK licensing is required — separate from OSS — and must be completed before commercial operations begin.

Kegiatan lembaga yang menempatkan dirinya di antara para pihak yang melakukan transaksi derivatif suku bunga dan nilai tukar sehingga bertindak sebagai pembeli bagi penjual dan sebagai penjual bagi pembeli, yang memiliki fungsi antara lain: novasi, yaitu proses pengakhiran kontrak awal antara pembeli dengan penjual kemudian menggantikannya dengan dua kontrak baru; penyelenggaraan kliring, yaitu penyelenggaraan proses yang dilakukan setelah terjadinya transaksi; dan pengelolaan risiko, atas transaksi derivatif suku bunga dan nilai tukar.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Money changer (licensed foreign exchange) activities — buying and selling foreign currency notes, traveler's checks, and conducting currency exchange transactions. A Bank Indonesia-regulated business that provides foreign exchange services to the public.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro / Small / Medium / Large scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate — issued automatically.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered/adjusted from KBLI 2020. KBLI 66125 invariato 2020→2025 (sotto categoria 6612 — Aktivitas Perantara Transaksi). Aggiornamento OSS entro 18 giugno 2026. BI regolatore esclusivo tramite PBI 6/2024 e PADG cor
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has one of Indonesia's densest money changer networks — tourist demand from international visitors creates massive foreign currency volume. Bank Indonesia (BI) licenses money changers as KUPVA BB (Kegiatan Usaha Penukaran Valuta Asing Bukan Bank). BI issued a moratorium on new money changer licenses in Jakarta but Bali licenses remain available. All transactions above IDR 25 million require customer identity verification (KYC/AML compliance under BI Regulation 19/2017). Cryptocurrency-to-fiat exchange is NOT permitted under a money changer license.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- Bank Indonesia KUPVA BB license — mandatory separate from OSS
- 64110 — If you want to operate as a full bank

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Investment advisory services — providing professional advice to clients on investment decisions, portfolio allocation, and financial planning, whether for securities, real estate, or other asset classes. You advise, you don't manage or trade on behalf of clients.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro / Small / Medium / Large scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate — issued automatically.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Unchanged from KBLI 2020 — direct match.
intel_2026.baliContext: Investment advisory in the securities market requires OJK registration as a Penasihat Investasi (PI) under POJK 10/2018. Advisors who manage client portfolios cross into fund management territory (66301). The growing number of wealthy foreigners investing in Bali's property and business market creates demand for locally-based investment advisors. IFRS and Indonesian PSAK accounting standards knowledge is important for cross-border advisory.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- OJK Penasihat Investasi license — if advising on securities
- 66301 — Investment management if you actively manage funds
