intel_2026.whatItMeans: Conventional fintech peer-to-peer lending platform — operating an online platform that facilitates direct lending between individual or institutional lenders and borrowers without going through a traditional bank. Often called P2P Lending or marketplace lending.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro / Small / Medium / Large scale**: Medium-Low risk. NIB + Standard Certificate — issued automatically.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered/adjusted from KBLI 2020. KBLI 66161 invariato 2020→2025. POJK 40/2024 framework attuale (sostituisce POJK 10/2022). UU P2SK base legislativa. Aggiornamento OSS entro 18 giugno 2026. POJK 3/2024 (ITSK) gove
intel_2026.baliContext: P2P lending in Indonesia is regulated by OJK under POJK 10/2022 (LPBBTI) — all platforms must register and then obtain full OJK licenses. Minimum paid-up capital Rp 25 billion (conventional). Maximum interest rates and penalty caps are set by AFPI (Indonesian Fintech Lending Association). Bali-based tech startups in Canggu have explored P2P lending models for tourism businesses and creative industry financing. Consumer protection regulations are strictly enforced.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- OJK P2P lending license — mandatory (registration then licensing)
- 66162 — Sharia P2P lending for Islamic finance version
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Building a P2P lending platform in Bali? Let me explain OJK licensing, minimum capital, and the regulatory framework under POJK 10/2022.

intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered/adjusted from KBLI 2020. KBLI 66162 invariato 2020→2025 come codice distinto dal convenzionale. POJK 40/2024 copre entrambe le versioni. Prima codificazione esplicita come attività separata nel KBLI 2025.
intel_2026.baliContext: Sharia P2P lending targets Indonesia's large underbanked Muslim population — significant addressable market. DSN-MUI fatwa compliance is required alongside OJK licensing. Minimum paid-up capital Rp 25 billion for sharia P2P. Bali serves as a tech hub for fintech development targeting Indonesia-wide Muslim markets — the operational HQ may be in Bali while the customer base spans Java and Sumatra.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Developing and selling residential real estate — buying, selling, and developing houses, apartments, flats, and residential land. This covers the full property development cycle: acquire land, build residential buildings, and sell or lease them. Mobile home park development for residential use also falls here.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Micro through Large)**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate (Sertifikat Standar) issued **automatically** (Otomatis).

**Key obligations:**
- **KKPR** (Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang) — spatial conformity permit for housing development, issued by ATR/BPN
- **Persyaratan Dasar** — basic business licensing requirements for smaller scales
- **MBR housing** (Masyarakat Berpenghasilan Rendah) — additional specific development requirements if building low-income housing
- **SK Pengesahan** from Pemda — master plan, land parcel split plans, management separation plans
- **Audited financials** — laporan keuangan audited by public accountant, with debt-to-equity ratios

**Authority chain:**

intel_2026.baliContext:
**The Governor's numbers (Surat Gubernur, Jan 2026):**
- **19,262** PMA businesses registered in Bali (2021–2025) — that's 40% of all PMA nationally

- The letter also requests closure of PMA at **virtual office addresses** in Bali
- **68111** is cited as the single most abused PMA code in the province

---

**Bali real estate reality:**
- Land prices in south Bali (Canggu, Seminyak, Jimbaran) have **tripled in the last decade**
- **KKPR** (spatial conformity) is critical — Bali has strict zoning near temples, rice terraces, and waterways
- Foreigners **cannot own land freehold** (Hak Milik) — must use PT PMA
- Typical structure: **HGB** (Hak Guna Bangunan — building rights, 30 years + 20 year extension) held by the PT PMA

---

- **Virtual office** for a real estate company — the Governor's letter specifically targets this, DPMPTSP Bali is actively flagging it

- **Hak Milik → HGB conversion** — assuming it's quick; in Bali, BPN processing can take 6–12 months
- **Ignoring the banjar** (local village council) — no government permits will save you if the banjar objects
- **Building first, permitting later** — IMB/PBG enforcement has intensified since 2024, with demolition orders actually executed in Canggu and Pererenan

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Advocate activities — representing clients in court, appearing before judges and tribunals, preparing legal pleadings, and providing formal legal defense. This is courtroom lawyering in the traditional sense: litigation, criminal defense, civil lawsuits, arbitration hearings. If someone is standing in front of a judge arguing your case, they're operating under this code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**WARNING: Effectively CLOSED to foreign investment.** While the KBLI data shows this as TERBUKA 100%, the Advocate Law (UU 18/2003) overrides this. Only Indonesian citizens who are registered members of PERADI (the Indonesian Bar Association) can practice as advocates. No foreign national — regardless of PMA structure — can appear in Indonesian courts.

**All scales (Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, Besar)**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, issued **automatically**.

**PMA:** The KBLI technically says open 100%, but this is misleading. Sector-specific legislation closes this to foreigners. Do NOT rely on the KBLI data alone — the Advocate Law is the binding constraint.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). The code itself hasn't changed, and neither has the legal reality — Indonesia's advocacy profession has been closed to foreigners since the Advocate Law was enacted in 2003.
intel_2026.baliContext: Foreign investors sometimes see this code's TERBUKA status and get excited. Don't. The Advocate Law is ironclad — no foreign citizen can practice as an advocate in Indonesia, full stop. If you need legal representation in Bali, you hire an Indonesian advocate. If you're a foreign lawyer wanting to work in Indonesia, look at 69102 (Legal Consultant) instead, which allows foreign firms to operate through Technical Assistance Agreements. Several international law firms have Bali-based consultants who advise on cross-border deals — but they cannot step into a courtroom.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Legal consulting — providing legal advice, contract drafting, corporate structuring, regulatory compliance guidance, and due diligence. This is the advisory side of law, not the courtroom side. Think corporate lawyers who never see a judge: they review contracts, advise on M&A, draft shareholder agreements, and navigate regulatory approvals.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, Besar)**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, issued **automatically**.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed. BUT — and this is important — foreign law firms cannot directly practice Indonesian law. You must operate through a Technical Assistance Agreement (TAA) with an Indonesian firm. The TAA structure means you partner with a local firm, provide international expertise, and share work. You can't just hang a shingle and start advising on Indonesian corporate law as a solo foreign entity.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: This is a MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE — the 2025 code consolidated multiple old legal consulting codes into one. If you had a more specific legal advisory code under KBLI 2020, it likely maps here now. The consolidation simplifies things: one code for all non-courtroom legal work.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the realistic path for foreign legal professionals in Bali. Several international firms have set up advisory operations — typically through TAA partnerships with Jakarta or Denpasar-based Indonesian firms. The work is mostly corporate: helping foreign investors structure PT PMAs, drafting joint venture agreements, navigating BKPM approvals, and handling cross-border commercial contracts. Bali's market is driven by the constant flow of new foreign businesses needing setup advice. If you're a qualified foreign lawyer, this code plus a TAA with a reputable Indonesian firm is your entry point. Denpasar has the most established legal infrastructure, but many consultants work from Canggu or Sanur offices.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Head office and holding company activities — overseeing and managing subsidiary companies, providing strategic direction, corporate governance, and group-level administration. This isn't about running a specific business; it's about running the businesses that run businesses. If you own multiple Indonesian companies and want a single entity to coordinate them, this is your code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:

- Submit quarterly Investment Activity Reports (LKPM) via OSS

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership. PP 28/2025 explicitly recognizes holding company activities as a valid PMA business line. Your equity stakes in subsidiaries count toward the IDR 10 billion investment realization requirement — you don't need to build factories or buy separate assets.

intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Holding companies were holding companies then, and they're holding companies now. The code, scope, and classification are unchanged.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the sophisticated investor's code. Your equity in the subsidiaries counts toward investment realization, which is a major advantage. In Bali, this structure is increasingly common among serial entrepreneurs who've built multiple businesses. The holding company typically sits in Denpasar (where notaries and corporate lawyers are concentrated) even if the operating businesses are in Canggu or Ubud. One catch: the absence of a Large-scale entry is unusual but doesn't block operations — most holding companies comfortably fit within the Medium scale definition.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: This is your code for running an architecture practice — building design, town planning, landscape architecture. It covers the full spectrum from concept sketches to construction documentation. Because buildings involve public safety, this sits at Medium-High risk across all business scales, which means real licensing requirements beyond just your NIB.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro through Besar): Medium-High Risk**

You need an NIB plus a Sertifikat Standar (Standard Certificate) with verification. The big requirement here is your SBU (Sertifikat Badan Usaha) issued by an accredited LSBU — this is your company-level construction services license. Your professional staff must hold SKA (Sertifikat Keahlian) or SKK (Sertifikat Kompetensi Kerja) certifications.

For PMA companies, you'll likely need to register as a BUJKA (Badan Usaha Jasa Konstruksi Asing) — the foreign construction services entity framework.

**PMA: 100% foreign ownership allowed.**

intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's building boom in hospitality and villa development means architecture firms stay busy, but local regulations are tightening around building heights, setbacks, and green zone compliance. You'll want staff who understand the Perda for each kabupaten, especially Badung and Gianyar where most development happens. Foreign architects often partner with locally-licensed firms to navigate the permit landscape faster.

Apabila sampai pada akhir masa berlakunya Izin Survei Umum, pemegang Izin tidak memiliki kontrak kerja sama, Izin Survei Umum dinyatakan tidak berlaku dan seluruh data hasil kegiatan Survei Umum wajib diserahkan kepada Pusat Data dan Teknologi Informasi ESDM b. Dalam hal Survei Umum melintasi Wilayah Kerja, Izin Survei Umum yang terdiri dari area di Wilayah Terbuka dan area di Wilayah Kerja yang dilintasi akan dituangkan pada 1 (satu) kontrak kerja sama terkait penyimpanan, pemeliharaan, dan pemasyara katan data antara Pemegang Izin Survei Umum dan Pusat Data dan Teknologi Informasi ESDM c. Kontrak kerja sama dengan Pusat Data dan Teknologi Informasi ESDM dapat dilakukan setelah Izin Survei Umum diterbitkan, dengan tanggal efektif kontrak yaitu sejak memenuhi realisasi luasan area, panjang lintasan, atau jumlah titik Survei Umum minimal 51% (lima puluh satu persen) di Wilayah Terbuka berdasark an hasil pemantauan pelaksanaan Survei Umum oleh Direktorat Jenderal Minyak dan Gas Bumi d. Apabila realisasi luasan area, panjang lintasan, atau jumlah titik Survei Umum lebih kecil dari yang tertuang dalam Izin Survei Umum, termasuk perubahan izinnya apabila ada, akan mengurangi secara proporsional jangka waktu kontrak kerja sama terkait penyimpanan, pemeliharaan, dan pemasyarakatan data

Dalam hal terjadi perubahan, baik luasan area, panjang lintasan, jumlah titik dan/atau lokasi survei di luar wilayah yang tercakup dalam Izin Survei Umum, pemegang Izin wajib: a.Mempertahankan realisasi pelaksanaan minimal 70% {tujuh puluh persen) di Wilayah Terbuka dalam hal Survei Umum melintasi Wilayah Kerja b. Apabila pemegang Izin Survei Umum tidak melaksanakan kewajiban sebagaimana dimaksud pada angka 2 dan angka 3, data tambahan yang dihasilkan dari perubahan luasan area, panjang lintasan, jumlah titik dan/atau lokasi survei wajib diserahkan kepada Pusat Data dan Teknologi Informasi ESDM setelah dievaluasi oleh Direktorat Jenderal Minyak dan Gas Bumi serta data menjadi milik negara dan pemegang izin tidak memiliki hak pemasyarakatan atas data tambahan

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Engineering design and technical consulting specifically for factories and industrial facilities — machinery layout, process engineering, plant construction planning. It's the heavier-duty sibling of general architecture, focused on industrial applications where safety stakes are highest.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Mikro/Kecil/Menengah: Medium-High Risk**
NIB + Sertifikat Standar with verification. SBU from an accredited LSBU required. Professional engineers must hold valid SKK certifications.

**Besar: High Risk (Tinggi)**
This is the highest risk classification in this batch. NIB + Sertifikat Standar with full verification, plus additional compliance obligations. Environmental impact assessments (AMDAL) may be required depending on the factory type.

For PMA, BUJKA registration applies.

**PMA: 100% foreign ownership allowed.**
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 — code and scope unchanged. The notable point is that Besar scale clearly sits at Tinggi (High) risk, reflecting stricter post-2020 industrial safety standards.
intel_2026.baliContext: Factory engineering work in Bali is niche — water treatment plants, food processing facilities, and manufacturing zones in Jembrana and Tabanan are the main drivers. - penelitian dan pengembangan di bidang ilmu kedokteran hewan, lihat kelompok 72105.

**Micro, Small, Medium**: Low risk (Rendah). Only an NIB is required, issued **automatically** (Otomatis).

**Large (Besar)**: **No PP28 entry exists** for Large-scale advertising. The regulatory data only covers Mikro/Kecil/Menengah. This may mean Large-scale operations require a separate licensing pathway or are simply not addressed in the current PP28 framework.

**Post-issuance obligations:**
- Submit periodic business activity reports to the Minister of Trade (Menyampaikan laporan kegiatan usaha kepada Menteri Perdagangan)

**Authority:** PP28 specifies "Gubernur Daerah Khusus Jakarta" — for operations outside Jakarta (including Bali), authority defaults to local Bupati/Walikota.

**PMA Status:** RESTRICTED (Terbatas) — **Maximum 49% foreign ownership.** Requires a formal partnership with a domestic business entity (Kemitraan dengan badan usaha dalam negeri).

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025, Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, 14/2024.
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_LANGSUNG. Unchanged from KBLI 2020. The protectionist limits on foreign ownership in media and advertising remain firmly in place.
intel_2026.baliContext: WARNING: This is the most common regulatory trap for digital nomads in Bali. Hundreds of foreigners arrive wanting to open a 'Digital Marketing Agency' or 'Social Media Agency' as a 100% foreign-owned PT PMA. You CANNOT do this under 73100. Advertising is strictly capped at 49% foreign ownership, meaning you must have an Indonesian corporate partner holding the majority share. To bypass this, smart foreign founders pivot their business models. Instead of 'Advertising,' they classify their business as 'Management Consulting' (70209) or the new 'Graphic Design' (74192) code, which are 100% open. If you use those workarounds, ensure you do not explicitly buy media (like billboard space or Facebook Ads) on behalf of clients.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 70209 — Management Consulting (the standard 100% PMA alternative for marketing strategists)
- 74192 — Graphic Design (if your agency focuses purely on the visual/creative asset side)
- 74209 — Photography Services (essential for content creation agencies)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Planning to start a digital marketing agency in Bali? Be very careful—KBLI 73100 is capped at 49% foreign ownership, so you might need to pivot your KBLI strategy.

While it shares methodology with market research, the subject matter is public opinion rather than commercial behavior, and that distinction matters more than you might expect.

Technically, it's NIB only — same low-risk classification as market research.

**However:** Political polling during election cycles faces heightened scrutiny, particularly around foreign funding and influence. While OSS treats this as standard low-risk, in practice you may encounter informal pushback from local authorities if your polling touches sensitive political topics.

**PMA: 100% foreign ownership allowed.**

intel_2026.baliContext: Bali-based opinion polling is uncommon — most polling firms operate from Jakarta. If you're setting up here, you're likely running a distributed research operation headquartered in Bali. For tourism-focused opinion research (visitor satisfaction, community attitudes toward development), Bali makes perfect sense as a base.

persyaratan: Standar Penetapan Kemampuan Badan Usaha Jasa Konstruksi / Sertifikat Badan Usaha (SBU) Subklasifikasi: AR003

Untuk Kantor Perwakilan BUJKA: a. Merupakan badan usaha jasa konstruksi berbadan hukum di negara asal b. Membayar biaya administrasi perizinan berusaha per jenis usaha sesuai peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku

Untuk BUJK PMA: a. Penanam modal asing/ pemegang saham asing merupakan badan usaha jasa konstruksi berbadan hukum di negara asal yang dibuktikan dengan: 1) Akta pendirian yang dilegalisasi 2) Sertifikat perizinan bidang usaha jasa konstruksi berkualifikasi Besar di negara asal atau yang sejenis yang dilegalisasi b. Penanam modal dalam negeri/ pemegang saham dalam negeri merupakan badan usaha jasa konstruksi nasional berkualifikasi Besar yang dibuktikan dengan: 1) Perizinan berusaha subsektor jasa konstruksi 2) Sertifikat Badan Usaha subsektor jasa konstruksi
kewajiban: Menyampaikan Laporan Kegiatan Usaha Tahunan
SBU masih berlaku
Melaksanakan ketentuan dalam peraturan perundang-undangan di bidang jasa konstruksi

Untuk Kantor Perwakilan BUJKA: a. Melakukan perpanjangan Sertifikat Standar sesuai subklasifikasi setiap 3 tahun b. Melakukan Kerja Sama Operasi (KSO) dengan BUJKN berkualifikasi Besar dan memiliki klasifikasi/ subklasifikasi sejenis yang tercatat di lembaga pengembangan jasa konstruksi sebelum mengikuti proses pemilihan c. KSO untuk pelaksanaan Jasa Konsultansi Konstruksi dilaksanakan dengan ketentuan kriteria teknis KSO sebagai berikut: 1) Seluruh pekerjaan jasa Konsultansi Konstruksi dilakukan di dalam negeri 2) Paling sedikit 50% (lima puluh persen) dari nilai pekerjaan jasa Konsultansi Konstruksi dikerjakan oleh BUJKN mitra KSO

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Interior design — planning and designing the inside of buildings and rooms based on human activities, room function, and desired atmosphere. Considering aesthetics, materials, textures, lighting, color, and furniture to create functional and beautiful spaces. This covers residential interiors, commercial spaces, hospitality design, and everything in between.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Brand new code (BPS_ONLY)** — no PP28/2025 licensing data published yet. The risk category and specific requirements are pending. NIB required at minimum.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Completely new code in KBLI 2025 (BPS_ONLY). In the 2020 classification, interior design was bundled into broader design categories. The 2025 overhaul created specific codes for each design discipline: industrial design (74111-74119), interior design (74191), graphic design (74192), film/video design (74193), game design (74194), and others. Interior design finally has its own dedicated code.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has a thriving interior design scene — driven by the constant pipeline of new villas, hotels, restaurants, and boutique spaces. The 'Bali style' (tropical modern, open-air, natural materials) is exported worldwide. Many international interior designers have set up studios in Bali, particularly in Seminyak and Canggu. The market ranges from budget villa fit-outs (IDR 200-500M) to ultra-luxury resort interiors (billions). Since this is a BPS_ONLY code with no PP28 data yet, licensing requirements are minimal for now — just NIB. Local craftsmen (stone carvers, woodworkers, furniture makers in Gianyar and Klungkung) are a major resource that makes Bali competitive for interior design globally.

- 74192 — If you also do graphic/brand design for hospitality clients
- 41011 — If you take on construction/renovation oversight

intel_2026.whatChanged: BPS_ONLY. Newly separated for KBLI 2025. Previously lumped into broader specialized design codes, graphic and visual communication design now has its own dedicated classification.
intel_2026.baliContext: This code is a massive win for Bali's creative expat community. Thousands of freelance graphic designers, branding experts, and UI/UX artists operate out of cafes in Canggu and Ubud. KBLI 74192 provides a clean, 100% PMA-open avenue to set up a legal entity, bill international clients, and sponsor your own Investor KITAS. You don't need a physical studio; a virtual office is perfectly fine. Ensure your client contracts state 'design deliverables' rather than 'ad placements' to stay compliant.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Patent brokerage — intermediating the buying, selling, and licensing of patents and intellectual property rights. Acting as a broker or agent between patent holders and companies seeking to acquire or license patented technologies. Not the creation of IP (which is R&D) but the commercial transaction of existing IP.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar)**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate issued automatically.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered in KBLI 2025 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). The activity existed under a different code number in 2020 — the scope is the same but the code changed. Update your NIB before the June 2026 deadline.
intel_2026.baliContext: Niche but growing in Indonesia as the startup ecosystem matures. Bali-based companies occasionally need patent brokerage for technology licensing (particularly in wellness tech, sustainable energy, and agritech). The more practical Bali use case: foreign entrepreneurs who hold patents in their home countries and want to license them to Indonesian companies through a local PMA entity. The IP brokerage market in Indonesia is still developing — Jakarta dominates, but having a Bali-registered entity with international IP expertise can serve the growing tech hub in Canggu and beyond.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 77400 — If you also lease/license IP (not just broker transactions)
- 69200 — If you provide IP-related accounting/advisory services
- 70201 — If you offer broader business consulting alongside IP brokerage
- 62199 — If you deal specifically with software patents and tech licensing

data.uraian: Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pelayanan jasa medik veteriner seperti pengawasan, perawatan, pemeriksaan, pengobatan, diagnosis, dan konsultasi kesehatan hewan untuk hewan ternak, hewan piaraan, hewan akuatik, dan satwa liar berupa tempat praktik pribadi atau perorangan mandiri yang dilakukan oleh dokter hewan; paramedik; asisten teknik reproduksi di bawah penyeliaan dokter hewan; ahli kiropraktik hewan; serta ahli gizi hewan untuk hewan kuda, akuatik, maupun satwa liar. Kelompok ini juga mencakup kegiatan ambulatori hewan.

kewajiban: Memiliki surat keterangan pemenuhan persyaratan teknis untuk Ambulatori, Praktik Dokter Hewan Mandiri, Puskeswan Mandiri, atau Klinik Hewan sesuai yang dipersyaratkan dalam ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan mengenai pelayanan jasa medik veteriner dari Dinas yang membidangi fungsi Peternakan dan Kesehatan Hewan atau Pejabat Otoritas Veteriner Kabupaten/ Kota selambat lambatnya 3 (tiga) bulan setelah perizinan berusaha diterbitkan

Memiliki surat keterangan pemenuhan persyaratan teknis untuk Praktik Dokter Hewan Mandiri Kuda, Praktik Dokter Hewan Mandiri Akuatik, atau Praktik Dokter Hewan Mandiri Satwa Liar sesuai yang dipersyaratkan dalam ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan mengenai pelayanan jasa medik veteriner dari Dinas yang membidangi fungsi Peternakan dan Kesehatan Hewan, Pejabat Otoritas Veteriner Kabupaten/ Kota, atau Pejabat Otoritas Veteriner Kesehatan Hewan paling lambat 3 (tiga) bulan setelah perizinan berusaha diterbitkan

Memiliki dokter hewan penanggungja wab untuk Klinik Hewan
Menggunakan obat hewan yang memiliki nomor pendaftaran, selama menjalankan kegiatan usaha
Menggunakan makanan hewan kesayangan yang memiliki nomor registrasi apabila menggunakan makanan hewan kesayangan komersial dalam menjalankan kegiatan usaha shelter hewan

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Recreational and sports equipment rental — operational leasing (rental without option to buy) of surfboards, bicycles, kayaks, camping gear, fitness equipment, and other recreational gear. You rent it out, the customer uses it, they bring it back. No purchase option involved.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Rendah (Low)** across all scales. Only NIB required, automatic issuance. Important distinction: this covers operational leasing only. Financial leasing (with purchase option) is regulated by OJK (Financial Services Authority) and requires a completely different licensing framework.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Aggregated from KBLI 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE) — combines 77210 with PP28 code 77220.
intel_2026.baliContext: Surfboard rental in Kuta and Canggu, bicycle rental in Ubud, kayak rental in Sanur — this is a tourism-adjacent business that's relatively easy to set up compared to more heavily regulated sectors. The capital requirements are manageable, the equipment is the main asset, and the market is steady as long as tourists keep coming. Many operators combine this with other tourism codes (93295 for beach, 93297 for water sports). Insurance for equipment damage and customer injury is strongly recommended even if not strictly mandated for all equipment types.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 77291 — If also renting other recreational equipment not covered here
- 93295 — If operating from a beach area
- 93297 — If the rental is part of a water tourism operation
- 79121 — If packaging equipment rental as part of tour packages
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Starting a surfboard, bicycle, or sports equipment rental in Bali? 77210 covers recreational equipment rental — a straightforward tourism-adjacent business.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Rental and leasing of water transport vessels — renting boats, yachts, speedboats, jet skis, and other watercraft to businesses or individuals without a crew (bare boat charter). The lessee operates the vessel themselves.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Micro scale**: Low risk. NIB only — issued automatically.


**PMA:** Fully open to PMA — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Unchanged from KBLI 2020 — direct match.
intel_2026.baliContext: Yacht and speedboat bare-boat charter is a niche business in Bali — the Benoa Marina and Serangan Marina are the main bases. KSOP Denpasar regulates vessel operation and charter businesses. Bare boat charter customers need their own skipper license (Sertifikat Keahlian Pelaut from DKHUB). Most tourists prefer crewed charters (which falls under 50113). Jet ski rental on Bali's beaches (Tanjung Benoa is the hub) is a regulated activity requiring environmental compliance permits.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 50113 — If you provide crewed tourist transport
- KSOP vessel permits — required for all charter vessels
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Water vessel rental or bare-boat charter in Bali? Let me explain KSOP licensing and how bare-boat charter differs from crewed tourist transport.

data.judul: Aktivitas Jasa Intermediasi untuk Penyewaan dan Sewa Guna Usaha Mobil
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas jasa intermediasi untuk penyewaan dan sewa guna usaha mobil, motorhome dan trailer, dengan mempertemukan klien dan penyedia layanan dengan biaya atau komisi, tanpa intermediator harus menyediakan layanan penyewaan dan sewa guna usaha untuk barang yang diperantarai. Aktivitas intermediasi ini dapat dilakukan pada platform digital maupun nondigital (tatap muka termasuk dari pintu ke pintu, telepon, surat, dll.). Biaya atau komisi dapat diterima baik dari klien maupun penyedia layanan penyewaan dan sewa guna usaha. Pendapatan untuk aktivitas intermediasi dapat mencakup sumber pendapatan lain, seperti pendapatan dari iklan.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup layanan reservasi untuk penyewaan mobil.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- penyewaan dan sewa guna usaha kendaraan atau truk dengan pengemudi, lihat subgolongan 4922, motorhome dan trailer, lihat subgolongan 4923;
- jasa intermediasi untuk transportasi penumpang, lihat subgolongan 5232.

data.judul: Aktivitas Jasa Intermediasi untuk Penyewaan dan Sewa Guna Usaha Barang Berwujud dan Aset Tak Berwujud Nonfinansial Lainnya
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa intermediasi untuk penyewaan dan sewa guna usaha barang berwujud dan aset tak berwujud nonfinansial dengan mempertemukan klien dan penyedia layanan dengan biaya atau komisi, tanpa intermediator harus menyediakan layanan penyewaan dan sewa guna usaha untuk barang yang diperantarai. Aktivitas intermediasi ini dapat dilakukan pada platform digital maupun nondigital (tatap muka termasuk dari pintu ke pintu, telepon, surat, dll.). Komisi dapat diterima dari klien atau penyedia layanan penyewaan. Pendapatan untuk kegiatan intermediasi dapat mencakup sumber pendapatan lain, seperti pendapatan dari iklan. Kelompok ini juga mencakup penyediaan intermediasi antara rumah tangga yang menawarkan barang mereka untuk disewa dan rumah tangga penyewa barang, misalnya pemotong rumput, tangga, dan sepeda.

- unit yang memiliki kepemilikan dari barang berwujud dan/atau aset keuangan nonfinansial tidak berwujud yang akhirnya disewa, lihat golongan 772 dan 773;
- penyewaan dan sewa guna usaha barang keperluan pribadi, barang-barang rumah tangga, dan peralatan serta barang-barang berwujud lainnya, lihat golongan 772 dan 773.

data.judul: Aktivitas Penempatan Tenaga Kerja untuk Usaha di Dalam Negeri
data.uraian: Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pendaftaran, penyeleksian dan penempatan tenaga kerja untuk kegiatan pada berbagai bidang usaha di dalam negeri. Dalam kelompok ini, tenaga kerja yang ditempatkan tidak berstatus sebagai pegawai dari perusahaan penempatan tenaga kerja. Kelompok ini juga mencakup penyediaan tenaga kerja eksekutif untuk pihak lain. Kelompok ini tidak mencakup penyediaan tenaga kerja untuk kegiatan rumah tangga sebagai pemberi kerja di dalam negeri, seperti penempatan asisten rumah tangga dan sopir pribadi, lihat kelompok 78102.

data.judul: Aktivitas Penyediaan Tenaga Kerja Sementara dan Penyediaan Sumber Daya Manusia Lainnya
data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyediaan pekerja untuk usaha klien selama periode waktu tertentu, baik untuk menggantikan sementara maupun menambah tenaga kerja klien. Dalam perjanjian kerja tersebut, agen ketenagakerjaan sementara atau penyedia sumber daya manusia adalah pemberi kerja dari pekerja individu yang dipekerjakan. Namun, klien bertanggung jawab atas pengawasan personel sementara. Kegiatan yang diklasifikasikan di sini tidak menyediakan pengawas langsung untuk pekerja yang ditempatkan pada pemberi kerja.
Unit yang diklasifikasikan dalam kelompok ini mewakili pemberi kerja resmi untuk karyawan dalam hal-hal yang berkaitan dengan penggajian, pajak, dan masalah fiskal dan sumber daya manusia lainnya, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab langsung atas pengawasan karyawan. Unit yang diklasifikasikan dalam kelompok ini melakukan berbagai tugas manajemen sumber daya manusia dan personel yang terkait dengan ketentuan ini.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa manajemen sumber daya manusia untuk pemberi kerja. Kegiatan ini dikhususkan untuk menyelenggarakan sumber daya manusia dan tugas manajemen personel. Kegiatan ini menyajikan riwayat kerja pekerja dalam hal yang berhubungan dengan upah, pajak dan masalah keuangan dan sumber daya lainnya termasuk penyedia jasa pekerja/buruh.
Kelompok ini juga mencakup kegiatan penempatan perawat bayi (baby sitter) dan pengasuh anak yang dipekerjakan oleh penyedia tenaga kerja, sedangkan perawat bayi (baby sitter) dan pengasuh anak yang dipekerjakan oleh majikan langsung masuk di subgolongan 7810.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup kegiatan layanan penagihan, lihat subgolongan 6920.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Private kindergarten — formal early childhood education for ages 4-6, emphasizing holistic child development through play-based learning. Priority enrollment is ages 5-6. This covers private (swasta) kindergartens specifically, not government-run ones.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**BPS_ONLY** — no PP28/2025 licensing data exists yet. Education is heavily regulated through separate ministry channels (Dinas Pendidikan), so licensing comes through education-specific pathways rather than the standard OSS risk framework.

**PMA:** Foreign ownership capped at 49-51% depending on bilateral agreements. You CANNOT operate via a standard PT PMA — you must use a Yayasan (Foundation) structure. International schools use the SPK (Satuan Pendidikan Kerjasama) framework, which has its own approval process through the Ministry of Education.
intel_2026.whatChanged: BPS_ONLY — this code appears in BPS classification data but has no PP28/2025 licensing framework yet. Private kindergarten licensing is handled through education-specific channels (Dinas Pendidikan), not the standard OSS risk framework.
intel_2026.baliContext: Growing demand from expat families with young children, especially in Ubud, Sanur, and Canggu where international kindergartens have been popping up. The Yayasan structure is fundamentally different from a profit-generating PT PMA — it's a non-profit foundation, and that changes everything about how money flows. Many foreign educators get tripped up by this: you can't just set up a PT PMA and call it a school. The SPK framework adds another layer of approval that takes 6-12 months minimum.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 85202 — If you also offer primary school (ages 7-12)
- 85312 — If expanding to junior secondary
- 85520 — If offering cultural/arts education programs alongside
- 85593 — If providing language courses as enrichment

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Private universities and higher education institutions — degree-granting institutions operated by private foundations or corporations. This covers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs. The institution must be accredited by BAN-PT (National Higher Education Accreditation Board) and approved by Kemendikbud (Ministry of Education, Culture, Research and Technology).
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales: High Risk (Tinggi)**
This is one of the heaviest licensing paths in the entire KBLI system. NIB + Izin (permit-based licensing). You need full Kemendikbud accreditation, which involves institutional review, faculty qualifications, curriculum approval, and facility inspections. The approval process can take 12-24 months.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed. But in practice, foreign universities typically partner with Indonesian foundations (yayasan) to navigate the regulatory landscape.

High risk at ALL scales — there is no “easy” entry point here.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered in KBLI 2025 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). The code was restructured from the 2020 classification but the regulatory substance is the same: private higher education remains one of the most heavily regulated business activities in Indonesia.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has a growing higher education scene beyond Udayana University (the main public institution). International programs, satellite campuses of Jakarta universities, and specialized institutions are appearing — particularly in Denpasar and Jimbaran. The opportunity for foreign investment lies in niche programs: hospitality management (given Bali's tourism economy), creative arts, sustainable development, and international business. Partnerships with established Indonesian universities (Udayana spinoffs, Warmadewa, STIKOM Bali) are the pragmatic entry path rather than building from scratch. The accreditation timeline alone makes this a long-term investment play.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Sports and Recreation Education — organizing non-degree training and camps in sports and recreational activities. This explicitly includes surf schools, yoga teacher training, martial arts dojos, equestrian training, swimming, and e-sports coaching led by professional instructors.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
This code is marked **BPS_ONLY**. It is a new KBLI 2025 classification with no PP28/2025 licensing data attached in OSS yet. Licensing risk and specific post-issuance obligations will be defined when KBLI 2025 officially goes live in the OSS system.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership allowed under non-formal education guidelines.
intel_2026.whatChanged: BPS_ONLY. This brings immense clarity to KBLI 2025 by consolidating surf schools, yoga teacher trainings (YTTs), and martial arts into one clean educational code.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the holy grail code for Bali's massive wellness and surf industries. Every Yoga Teacher Training (YTT) in Ubud and Surf School in Uluwatu will operate under this classification. It is a highly lucrative, high-margin business, completely open to foreign ownership. However, the true trap here isn't the corporate license—it's immigration and manpower laws. If you open a PT PMA under 85510 and hire foreign yoga teachers or surf coaches, they MUST possess a valid Working KITAS with a proper IMTA (work permit) declaring them as 'Master Trainers'. Bali Immigration regularly raids yoga studios and surf camps for foreigners 'teaching' on tourist or investor visas.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Private hospitality and tourism training — training programs that build skills and expertise in the hotel and tourism industry, run by private (non-government) organizations. Barista courses, hotel management training, tour guide certification programs, hospitality service excellence workshops — if it's a private-sector training operation focused on tourism/hospitality skills, this is it.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Brand new code (BPS_ONLY)** — no PP28/2025 licensing data published yet. Specific risk category and requirements are pending. NIB required at minimum.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Completely new code in KBLI 2025 (BPS_ONLY). The 2020 classification didn't have this level of specificity for tourism/hospitality training. Previously, such programs fell under general vocational training codes. The 2025 split recognizes tourism training as its own category — alongside separate codes for tech training (85572), creative industry training (85573), business training (85575), and others.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's hospitality industry constantly needs trained staff — hotels, restaurants, villas, and tour companies all struggle to find qualified people. Private training centers fill this gap. Programs range from basic hotel housekeeping training to professional barista academies to comprehensive hospitality management courses. Denpasar has several established hospitality schools. There's growing demand for specialized training: wellness therapists, mixology/bartending, and sustainable tourism practices. Since this is a BPS_ONLY code, the licensing details are still pending — but the opportunity is clear in Bali's tourism-driven economy.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Other Private Job Training — providing non-formal private educational training not classified elsewhere. This includes personal development, motivational training, neuro-linguistic programming (NLP), career development courses, and specific occupational health & safety (K3) methodologies.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
This code is marked **BPS_ONLY**. It is a new KBLI 2025 classification without current PP28/2025 licensing data mapped in OSS. Processing details and obligations are pending the OSS system update.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: BPS_ONLY. A new catch-all training code introduced to cover the rapidly expanding personal development, life coaching, and corporate training sectors.
intel_2026.baliContext: Ubud is the global capital of 'life coaches,' breathwork facilitators, and corporate wellness retreats. Historically, running a 'Mastermind Retreat' or 'Self-Development Workshop' fell into a legal gray area, leading to frequent immigration deportations for foreigners hosting paid events on tourist visas. KBLI 85579 provides a legal, 100% foreign-owned umbrella for these personal development and NLP training businesses. Setting up a PT PMA under this code allows you to legally market, ticket, and host workshops. Because you don't need a dedicated facility (you can rent event spaces at hotels), overhead is extremely low.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: IT and computer education — training programs focused on information technology, computer science, programming, and digital skills. This covers coding bootcamps, IT certification courses, computer literacy training, and specialized tech skill development. Non-degree programs that teach people how to use, build, or manage technology.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi)**
NIB + Sertifikat Standar within **14 working days**. Requires a Self-Assessment of Standard Readiness document and compliance with education sector standards.

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered in KBLI 2025 (CODICE_RINUMERATO). The code was restructured from the 2020 classification. IT education was previously covered under broader computer services or education codes — the 2025 system gives it a dedicated classification reflecting the sector's importance.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's digital nomad ecosystem creates natural demand for coding bootcamps and IT training. Canggu is ground zero — co-working spaces like Dojo, Outpost, and Tropical Nomad already host informal tech workshops. Formal coding bootcamps (Le Wagon opened a Bali campus, various indie bootcamps operate in Ubud and Canggu) use this code. The market is international students who want to learn to code while living in Bali. Also relevant: local Balinese youth tech training programs supported by the provincial government. If you combine this with 85573 (creative industry training), you cover the full 'digital creative' education spectrum.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:

- 62199 — If you also develop software alongside teaching

Medical tourism is growing: Australian and Asian patients come for dental work, cosmetic surgery, and wellness treatments at a fraction of home-country prices. Location matters enormously — proximity to tourist areas for medical tourism, or underserved areas like Karangasem and Buleleng for gap-filling.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: General medical practitioner — individual doctor's practice providing primary healthcare, consultations, check-ups, and basic medical treatment. This is the family doctor / GP model. The practitioner sees patients, diagnoses common conditions, prescribes medication, and refers to specialists when needed.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**All scales: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi)**
NIB + Sertifikat Standar within **14 working days**. Requires SIP (Surat Izin Praktik / Practice License) and STR (Surat Tanda Registrasi / Registration Certificate) from the Indonesian Medical Council (KKI).

**PMA:** Fully open — 100% foreign ownership. Foreign doctors must have their credentials validated by KKI and meet Indonesian medical practice requirements.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). General practitioner practice classification unchanged between versions.
intel_2026.baliContext: GP practices in Bali serve both the local population and the growing expat/digital nomad community. There's a gap in English-speaking general practice — most international-facing medical care is hospital-based (BIMC, Siloam). A standalone GP practice targeting the expat community in Canggu, Ubud, or Sanur could fill this gap. The challenge: foreign doctors must navigate KKI credential validation, which can take 6-12 months. Many foreign medical professionals choose to partner with an Indonesian doctor who holds the SIP while they provide consultancy or specialized expertise.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 86105 — If you operate a clinic (multiple practitioners)
- 86202 — If you also offer specialist consultations

A platform connecting patients with verified healthcare providers, facilitating appointments, and handling medical tourism logistics could tap a large market. Existing players like Halodoc and Alodokter serve the national market; there's room for a Bali-specific service targeting the international community. Since there's no PP28 data yet, this is a low-friction entry — build the platform, establish the network, and be ready when full licensing requirements are published.

Ubud is the epicenter — it's practically become a global wellness pilgrimage destination. The business opportunity: packaging traditional Balinese wellness for international audiences, combining Balian wisdom with modern health standards. Be respectful — this sits at the intersection of business and Balinese Hindu culture. Working with local healers as partners rather than employees is culturally appropriate.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Fitness center / gym — providing physical fitness facilities and equipment for exercise and training. Covers commercial gyms, boutique fitness studios, CrossFit boxes, Pilates studios, and multi-equipment training centers. If people pay to use exercise equipment in your building, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Kecil / Menengah / Besar scale**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically**. Post-issuance: Self-Assessment document, LSPr-certified tourism business standard (required for PMA), Health Feasibility Certificate (SLS).

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Same code, same scope. Fitness centers have been consistently classified.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's fitness scene has exploded. Canggu alone has Body Factory, S2S CrossFit, Finns Recreation Club, and dozens of boutique studios. The digital nomad crowd drives demand for premium gym memberships (IDR 1-3 million/month). Uluwatu and Pererenan are the next growth zones. The business model ranges from budget gyms (high volume, low price) to premium boutique concepts (yoga-meets-gym, functional training). Equipment import is a significant upfront cost — commercial-grade gym equipment from brands like Technogym or Life Fitness carries heavy import duties. Many operators lease equipment to manage cash flow.

- 93127 — Fitness/Bodybuilding Club (if operating a membership-based club model)
- 85510 — Sports Education (if offering certified personal training courses)
- 56304 — Beverage Shop (smoothie/juice bar inside the gym)
- 93111 — Stadium Facilities (if your facility includes outdoor sports areas)

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Golf club — operating a golf course and associated facilities. Covers the course itself, driving ranges, pro shops, clubhouse operations, and membership management. Premium recreational infrastructure.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Mikro / Kecil scale**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 working days**. Self-Assessment required. LSPr-certified tourism standard + Health Feasibility Certificate.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). Same code, same scope.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali has established golf clubs — New Kuta Golf (Pecatu), Bali National Golf Club (Nusa Dua), Bali Handara (Bedugul), and Nirwana Bali Golf (Tanah Lot area). The market is premium and exclusive — green fees run IDR 1-3 million for non-members. Land requirements are enormous (50-80 hectares minimum), making new golf course development virtually impossible in south Bali due to land scarcity and the construction moratorium. North Bali (Singaraja) is the only realistic zone for new development. Water usage is a critical concern — golf courses consume enormous quantities and face increasing regulatory scrutiny.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Sports event organizer — planning, managing, and executing sporting events and competitions. Covers marathons, triathlons, surf competitions, cycling races, MMA fight nights, and any organized sporting event where the business is the event itself, not the venue.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:

intel_2026.baliContext: Bali hosts significant sporting events — the Bali Marathon, Ironman 70.3 Bali (when scheduled), international surf competitions (WSL events at Keramas), and a growing calendar of fitness events (Hyrox, obstacle course races). The PMA opportunity is in event management: securing sponsorships, managing logistics, handling international athlete registrations, and building recurring annual events. Government permits for road closures and public gatherings are the biggest logistical hurdle — start the Andalalin (traffic impact) process early. Event insurance is mandatory.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Theme Parks and Amusement Parks — operating permanent, location-based attractions such as mechanical rides, water parks, themed exhibitions, and picnic grounds where customers pay an entrance ticket. It explicitly excludes gambling and lottery operations.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
Two licensing tiers from aggregated PP28 sources (93219, 93211):

**Tier 1 — Menengah/Besar**: High risk (Tinggi). NIB + License (Izin) within **14 days**. Self-Assessment required. LSPr-certified Tourism Business Standard + Health Feasibility Certificate (Sertifikat Laik Sehat). Authority: Menteri/Kepala Badan. **Note:** This tier is flagged as `dati_inferiti` (inferred data) in our PP28 mapping — the licensing requirements were extrapolated from the old source codes (93219/93211), not directly published for 93210. Treat with caution and verify with OSS when KBLI 2025 is integrated.

**Tier 2 — Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate issued **automatically** (Otomatis). Health Feasibility Certificate required. LSPr certification for PMA companies. Self-Assessment document for theme park/amusement standards. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025 (aggregated from 93219, 93211).
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. Merged and cleaned up from previous KBLI 2020 codes to explicitly consolidate theme parks and water parks into one category.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is the big leagues. If you are building a water park (like Waterbom), a massive cultural park, or a large-scale beach club that operates primarily as an amusement venue with immersive attractions, 93210 is your code. The capital expenditure is astronomical, and so is the red tape. A High-Risk classification means your NIB is virtually useless until you pass rigorous Environmental Impact Assessments (AMDAL or UKL-UPL) and deal directly with Ministerial levels in Jakarta. Water rights (SIPA) for waterparks in Bali are currently highly contested due to the island's dropping water table, meaning securing extraction permits can take over a year. You must also have profound alignment with the local Desa Adat (Customary Village) regarding traffic management.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — Restaurants (for the massive F&B venues inside the park)
- 47192 — Non-Food Retail (for the inevitable gift shops and merchandise stores)
- 90200 — Performing Arts (if your theme park features live theatrical or cultural dance performances)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Planning a massive waterpark or themed attraction? KBLI 93210 is a High-Risk code requiring Ministerial approval and strict environmental impact studies.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Dance venue / dance floor — providing a venue primarily for dancing. Covers nightclubs (where dancing is the primary activity), dedicated dance venues, ballroom dance studios, and social dance spaces. The emphasis is on the dance activity itself, not food/drink service.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Mixed risk profile**: Medium-Low to Medium-High risk depending on scale and sub-activity. Consolidated from multiple KBLI 2020 codes. Exact requirements vary — check OSS for your specific scale.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Consolidated from multiple KBLI 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE). The aggregation brings together various dance-related entertainment codes under a single classification.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's nightlife scene runs deep — Seminyak (La Favela, Motel Mexicola), Kuta (Sky Garden), and increasingly Canggu. Dance venues face the highest regulatory scrutiny due to the entertainment tax (PBJT), noise ordinances, and the Governor's periodic crackdowns on late-night entertainment. The entertainment tax can be 40-75% on top of your revenue — this is not a typo, it's the most punishing tax category in Bali. Hours of operation are regulated and enforced. Banjar relations are critical — noise complaints from neighbors can shut you down faster than any government agency.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:

- 56101 — Restaurant (if serving food)
- 90001 — Performing Arts (if hosting live DJ/music performances)
- 93292 — Karaoke (if including karaoke rooms)

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Beach tourism — providing facilities for enjoying beach beauty. This covers renting out beach chairs and umbrellas, managing basic beach facilities, and beach area management. If you're running a business that monetizes access to or enjoyment of a beach area, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Menengah Tinggi (Medium-High)** across all scales. NIB + Sertifikat Standar required, 14-day issuance at Governor level. Must complete self-assessment (Penilaian Mandiri). Post-issuance: obtain Sertifikat Standar Usaha Pariwisata from LSPr and Sertifikat Laik Sehat (SLS). Maritime permit (Surat Izin Wisata Bahari) needed if operating on the sea for 30+ days.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed. Zoning is critical: OSS will auto-reject if your location isn't zoned for beach exploitation.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Aggregated from KBLI 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE) — combines 93295 with PP28 code 93245.
intel_2026.baliContext: This is CRITICAL for beach clubs — and here's where it gets complicated. A 'beach club' in Bali typically needs MULTIPLE KBLI codes: 56101 (restaurant), 56301 (bar), 93295 (beach area), and potentially 90xxx codes for entertainment. You can't just pick one. The Sempadan Pantai (100-meter setback line from high tide) is strictly enforced, and Bali's coastal zoning regulations add another layer. Many beach clubs in Seminyak and Canggu have faced enforcement actions for building too close to the waterline. OSS auto-rejects if the location isn't zoned for beach exploitation — check your RDTR (spatial plan) first.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 56101 — If serving food (restaurant license)
- 56301 — If serving alcohol (bar license)
- 93297 — If offering water sports activities

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Agro tourism — providing tourism experiences centered on agriculture, farming, and food production. Covers coffee plantation tours, rice terrace walks, organic farm visits, spice garden tours, and agricultural education experiences.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Mixed risk profile**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi) across most scales. Consolidated from multiple KBLI 2020 codes. NIB + Standard Certificate required.

**Menengah / Besar scale**: Medium-High (Menengah Tinggi). LSPr certification and Health Certificate required.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA) — 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Consolidated from multiple KBLI 2020 codes (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE). Agro tourism is now explicitly recognized as a distinct tourism category.
intel_2026.baliContext: Agro tourism is deeply embedded in Bali's appeal — luwak coffee plantation visits (Tegallalang/Kintamani), Jatiluwih rice terrace walks (UNESCO World Heritage), chocolate factory tours (Jasmine Kitchen near Sanur), and the growing organic farm-to-table movement. The PMA model that works best: lease agricultural land, develop a visitor experience (guided tours, workshops, tastings), and integrate with F&B (on-site cafe serving farm produce). Tegallalang and Ubud are the most established areas. The medium-high risk classification reflects the dual nature of the business — you're managing both an agricultural operation and a tourism destination. Subak (traditional irrigation) cooperatives control water access for rice operations and must be consulted.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Water tourism (Tirta) — water-based tourism activities including rafting, snorkeling, diving operations, water sports, river tourism, and lake recreation. If your business puts tourists on, in, or under water for fun, this is the code.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**Risk: Rendah (Low)** for Small/Medium/Large scales. Only NIB required, automatic issuance. Separate safety certifications required for each water activity type. Insurance for participants is mandatory.

**PMA:** Fully open (TERBUKA), 100% foreign ownership allowed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: Renumbered code (CODICE_RINUMERATO) — was 93246 in KBLI 2020, now 93297 in 2025. Scope expanded to explicitly include rafting, diving, snorkeling, free diving, sea walker, marina activities, surfing, jet ski, parasailing, and submarine experiences.
intel_2026.baliContext: Bali's water tourism is massive — diving in Tulamben, Amed, and Nusa Penida; rafting on the Ayung River; water sports in Tanjung Benoa. Each activity type has its own safety certification requirements on top of the KBLI licensing. Dive operators need PADI/SSI shop certification and specific insurance. Rafting operators need river safety certifications. The insurance requirement isn't optional — if someone gets hurt without coverage, you're looking at criminal liability, not just civil. Pro tip: partner with established operators while building your reputation rather than going solo from day one.

Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa reparasi dan pemeliharaan peralatan rumah tangga, seperti kulkas, kompor, mesin cuci, pengering pakaian, pendingin ruangan (AC), setrika listrik, alat penghisap debu dan berbagai barang/perabot listrik lainnya untuk keperluan rumah tangga, termasuk jasa reparasi dan perawatan peralatan rumah dan kebun, seperti mesin pemotong rumput, edger, penyapu salju dan daun, trimmer, dan sebagainya.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup
- reparasi dan pemeliharaan perkakas tangan yang bertenaga mesin, lihat subgolongan 3312;
- reparasi dan pemeliharaan sistem pendingin udara terpusat, lihat subgolongan 4322.

data.judul: Jasa Intermediasi Reparasi dan Perawatan Komputer, Barang Pribadi dan Rumah Tangga, Mobil, serta Sepeda Motor
data.uraian: Kelompok ini mencakup jasa intermediasi dalam reparasi dan perawatan komputer, barang pribadi dan rumah tangga, mobil, dan sepeda motor dengan cara mempertemukan pihak pengguna dan penyedia jasa berdasarkan imbalan atau komisi, tanpa intermediator menyediakan jasa yang diintermediasikan. Kegiatan intermediasi dapat dilakukan melalui platform digital atau melalui kanal nondigital (tatap muka, termasuk door-to-door; telepon; surat; dan lainnya). Imbalan atau komisi dapat diterima dari pihak pengguna atau penyedia jasa reparasi. Pendapatan dari kegiatan intermediasi juga dapat mencakup sumber lain, seperti pendapatan dari iklan.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Washing and Dry Cleaning of Textiles and Fur — covers commercial laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, carpet cleaning, curtain cleaning, and uniform/linen rental services. It applies to services operated mechanically, by hand, or coin-operated, for both the general public and industrial/commercial clients. It explicitly excludes clothing alterations.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
This code aggregated 5 old PP28 sources (96112, 96121, 96129, 96122, 96111), creating a **complex multi-tier risk structure** where risk depends on BOTH scale AND sub-activity type:

**Tier 1 — General commercial laundry (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah)**: Low risk (Rendah). NIB only, **automatic**. Report to Minister of Trade. Authority: Gubernur Daerah Khusus Jakarta (outside Jakarta: Bupati/Walikota).

**Tier 2 — Tourism-integrated laundry (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah)**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB only, **automatic**. Periodic activity reports. Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 3 — Full-service with tourism standards (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar)**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate, **automatic**. Self-Assessment document. Health Feasibility Certificate (SLS). LSPr-certified tourism standard (required for PMA). Authority: Bupati/Walikota.

**Tier 4 — Higher-complexity operations (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah)**: Medium-High risk (Menengah Tinggi). NIB + Standard Certificate within **14 days**. Self-Assessment required. LSPr certification + Health Certificate. Authority: Gubernur.

**Tier 5 — Large-scale industrial/clinical (Besar)**: High risk (Tinggi). NIB + Izin. Medical staff competence certificates required (Sertifikat kompetensi tenaga medis) — this applies to hospital linen and clinical bio-waste handling. Authority: Menteri/Kepala Badan. **No fictitious positive** — approval must be explicitly granted.

**PMA Status:** Fully open (Terbuka) — 100% foreign ownership.

**Source Regulation:** PP 28/2025 (aggregated from old codes 96111, 96112, 96121, 96122, 96129).
intel_2026.whatChanged: MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE. Consolidated from multiple fragmented cleaning codes in the previous system into a single comprehensive textile cleaning category.
intel_2026.baliContext: Commercial laundry is one of the most stable, unglamorous, yet highly profitable B2B businesses in Bali. Every villa, hotel, and spa needs reliable daily linen turnaround. However, operating a large-scale laundry PT PMA faces one massive, existential hurdle: water. You cannot simply dump chemical detergent wastewater into the local subak (irrigation) system. Villages (Banjars) and the Environmental Agency (DLHK) will shut you down immediately. You must invest heavily in a proper Wastewater Treatment Plant (IPAL) and secure a Groundwater Extraction Permit (SIPA). Finding industrial-zoned land away from tourist centers (like in Denpasar or Tabanan) is the smartest play to keep costs down.
intel_2026.youllAlsoNeed:
- 49231 — Road Freight Transport (if you are operating a fleet of vans for pickup and delivery)
- 46411 — Wholesale of Textiles (if you also sell wholesale linens to the hotels you service)
- 95291 — Clothing Repair (if you offer uniform alterations alongside dry cleaning)
intel_2026.zantaraOpener: Commercial laundry is a B2B goldmine in Bali's hospitality sector, but under KBLI 96100, your biggest hurdle will be strict wastewater compliance.

data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan yang menyediakan pelayanan kebugaran dan perawatan dengan memadukan metode tradisional dan modern secara holistik. Aktivitas ini menggunakan air dan pendukung perawatan lainnya berupa pijat menggunakan ramuan, terapi aroma, latihan fisik, terapi warna, terapi musik, makanan dan minuman. Tujuan aktivitas ini menyeimbangkan antara tubuh (body), pikiran (mind), dan jiwa (soul), sehingga terwujud kondisi relaks dan bugar untuk kesehatan yang optimal. Aktivitas ini juga merupakan upaya mempertahankan tradisi dan budaya bangsa.
Kelompok ini mencakup
- aktivitas pemandian Turki, sauna, dan pemandian uap, spa harian, solarium, salon pelangsing dan pengecilan tubuh, dan lainnya.
Subgolongan tidak mencakup
- layanan kesejahteraan fisik sebagai bagian dari aktivitas akomodasi, lihat golongan pokok 55l
- aktivitas terapis pijat medis, lihat subgolongan 8699;
- aktivitas praktisioner di bidang shiatsu, pijat Thailand, watsu, tuina qigong, lihat subgolongan 8699;
- aktivitas klub dan fasilitas kesehatan, kebugaran, dan pembentukan tubuh, lihat subgolongan 9311.

data.uraian: Kelompok ini mencakup jasa intermediasi jasa perorangan yang mempertemukan klien dan penyedia layanan dengan biaya atau komisi, tanpa intermediator yang menyediakan layanan yang diintermediasikan. Kegiatan intermediasi ini dapat dilakukan melalui platform digital maupun melalui saluran nondigital (tatap muka, termasuk door-to-door; telepon; surat). Imbalan atau komisi dapat diterima baik dari klien maupun penyedia layanan pribadi. Pendapatan dari kegiatan intermediasi dapat mencakup sumber pendapatan lain, seperti pendapatan dari iklan. Kelompok ini juga mencakup kegiatan agen penatu dan dry cleaning.

intel_2026.whatItMeans: Personal services intermediary — a platform that connects clients with personal service providers. Spa/massage bookings, beauty service aggregators, personal service matching platforms. You're the matchmaker between the person who wants a service and the person who provides it.
intel_2026.whatYouNeed:
**BPS_ONLY** — no PP28/2025 licensing data exists yet. This is a newer concept reflecting the platform economy.

**PMA:** No specific Kepmen 228 category — KEDUA-only. Foreign owners can hold Director/Commissioner positions but no sector-specific TKA positions are listed.
intel_2026.whatChanged: New in KBLI 2025 — refined intermediary definition for the personal services sector. The platform economy is finally getting its own classification rather than being shoehorned into generic IT or service codes.
intel_2026.baliContext: The platform economy for beauty and wellness services is growing fast in Bali. Think apps that let you book a massage therapist to your villa, or platforms aggregating spa services across Ubud. Critical tax issue to be aware of: 'Spa' classified as entertainment can face 40-75% PBJT (entertainment tax). You must clarify whether your platform connects users with 'wellness/health' services (lower tax bracket) or 'entertainment/spa' services (higher tax bracket). The classification makes a massive difference to your margins and your service providers' pricing.

Kelompok ini memungkinkan pekerja rumah tangga (PRT) untuk menyebutkan kegiatan pemberi kerjanya dalam sensus atau penelitian, meskipun pemberi kerja tersebut adalah perorangan atau rumah tangga. Produk yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan ini dikonsumsi oleh rumah tangga pemberi kerja.
Kelompok ini tidak mencakup penyediaan jasa perorangan dan rumah tangga, seperti membersihkan, menyetrika, memasak, merawat taman, layanan perawatan di rumah untuk pihak yang membutuhkan, oleh penyedia jasa (berorientasi laba, nirlaba, organisasi publik, maupun pekerja mandiri), lihat sesuai jenis layanan.

data.uraian:
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan rumah tangga dalam menghasilkan jasa pokok, seperti memasak, mengajar atau mendidik, merawat atau menjaga anggota rumah tangga dan jasa lain yang dihasilkan oleh rumah tangga untuk kebutuhannya sendiri.
Dalam praktiknya, jika rumah tangga tersebut juga terkait dalam memproduksi berbagai macam jasa untuk memenuhi kebutuhan sendiri, maka diklasifikasikan dalam kegiatan rumah tangga yang menghasilkan jasa untuk memenuhi kebutuhan sendiri.

data.judul: Aktivitas Badan Internasional dan Badan Ekstra Internasional Lainnya
data.uraian: Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan lembaga/badan/instansi dari perwakilan negara asing, badan internasional dan regional lainnya, badan keuangan dan moneter internasional, bank dunia, organisasi bea cukai dunia, organisasi untuk kerjasama dan pengembangan ekonomi, organisasi negara-negara pengekspor minyak, perhimpunan negara-negara Eropa, perhimpunan perdagangan bebas negara-negara Eropa dan lain-lain, seperti perwakilan PBB dan suborganisasi, UNICEF, UNESCO, UNDP, WHO, ILO, ASEAN, IMF, OECD dan OPEC dan lain-lain serta kedutaan besar, konsulat, pangkalan militer, pangkalan ilmiah, dan lain-lain yang ditentukan oleh negara dimana berada daripada negara yang diwakilinya.
